title: Density evolution at fluid-fluid interfaces: A generalized Gibbs-Duhem theory
summary: The classical Gibbs-Duhem relation applies to quasi-static processes and neglects kinetic effects, leaving a fundamental gap between Gibbs thermodynamics and Newtonian mechanics. Here, we derive a generalized Gibbs-Duhem framework that incorporates kinetic contributions, thereby establishing a unified connection between classical thermodynamics and Newtonian mechanics. Based on this framework, we propose an alternative evolution equation governing density dynamics at fluid-fluid interfaces. In appropriate limiting cases, the resulting density evolution equation naturally recovers the definition of the speed of sound, Bernoulli's law, and the van der Waals equation of state (EOS).

AI.tldr: 本文推导了包含动力学贡献的广义Gibbs-Duhem框架，建立了经典热力学与牛顿力学的统一联系，并提出了流体-流体界面密度演化的新方程，该方程在极限情况下可恢复声速定义、伯努利定律和范德瓦尔斯状态方程。
AI.motivation: 经典Gibbs-Duhem关系仅适用于准静态过程，忽略了动力学效应，导致Gibbs热力学与牛顿力学之间存在根本性的鸿沟。作者旨在弥合这一差距，建立统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 通过推导包含动力学贡献的广义Gibbs-Duhem框架，将热力学与力学统一；进而提出流体-流体界面处密度动力学的替代演化方程。
AI.result: 所得密度演化方程在适当极限下可自然恢复声速定义、伯努利定律和范德瓦尔斯状态方程。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为连接经典热力学与牛顿力学提供了统一的理论基础，并为界面动力学研究提供了新的数学工具。

title: Bulk and microphase separation in chiral active systems
summary: Many active particles phase-separate due to quorum-sensing interactions, and their self-propulsion mechanisms often break chiral symmetry. Using particle and continuum models, we uncover the role of chirality in inducing bulk or microphase separation, including a chiral phase formed of vapor bubbles. Analytical predictions for the emergence of these phases require a coarse-graining technique based on multiple-scale analysis. Further, introducing a minimal active field theory, we show that, in the bulk phase separation regime, chirality does not alter the diffusive $t^{1/3}$ coarsening law nor the dynamical exponent associated with capillary waves, but induces traveling waves at the interface. We finally demonstrate that, even in the absence of fluid flows, chirality can cause the breakup of elongated droplets, resembling phenomena previously observed experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了手性（chirality）在自驱动粒子群体感应相分离中的作用，揭示了手性可诱导体相分离或微相分离（包括由蒸汽泡形成的手性相）。通过多尺度分析的粗粒化方法进行理论预测，并构建最小活性场理论，发现手性不影响粗糙化指数和毛细波动力学指数，但会在界面处诱导行波，并导致液滴断裂。
AI.motivation: 许多活性粒子因群体感应相互作用而发生相分离，且其自推进机制常破坏手性对称性。作者旨在揭示手性在这种相分离过程中的具体作用机制。
AI.method: 采用粒子模型和连续介质模型相结合的方法，通过基于多尺度分析的粗粒化技术进行理论预测，并引入最小活性场理论框架进行系统分析。
AI.result: 手性可诱导体相分离或微相分离（含蒸汽泡形成的手性相）；在体相分离区间，手性不改变扩散控制的$t^{1/3}$粗化定律和毛细波的动力学指数，但会在界面处诱导行波；即使无流体流，手性也可导致长液滴断裂。
AI.conclusion: 手性在活性粒子群体感应相分离中扮演关键角色，可产生新型相分离模式（如手性蒸汽泡相），并诱导界面行波和液滴断裂等独特动力学现象。

title: Harvesting Reshapes Dynamical Populations
summary: Harvesting -- the periodic removal of individuals above or below a threshold trait value -- reshapes heterogeneous populations without altering their underlying stochastic dynamics. We study how repeated harvesting events steer the evolution of probability densities for classes of stochastic processes exhibiting both normal and anomalous dynamics, as well as a prototypical predator-prey model. Removal of the upper portion of the density drives the system to a quasi-steady state when viewed at the ``harvesting clock''. This state depends only on the harvesting threshold and frequency but not on the initial conditions. Removal of the lower portion of the density fixes its shape while generating a constant effective drift that exceeds that of the unharvested mean. Our results suggest the possibility of manipulating the dynamics of stochastic populations through external selection interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了重复“收获”（按阈值去除个体）如何重塑随机种群的密度演化，发现去除高值部分使系统达到与初始条件无关的准稳态，而去除低值部分则产生恒定有效漂移，表明可通过外部选择干预操控随机种群动态。
AI.motivation: 探索在保持随机动态不变的前提下，通过周期性阈值去除（收获）来塑造异质性种群的概率密度演化规律。
AI.method: 对具有正常和反常动力学的随机过程以及经典的捕食者-猎物模型进行理论分析，研究重复收获事件对概率密度演化的影响。
AI.result: 去除高值部分驱动系统达到仅取决于收获阈值和频率的准稳态；去除低值部分固定密度形状并产生超过未收获均值的恒定有效漂移。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了通过外部选择干预调控随机种群动态的可能性，为种群管理提供了新的理论工具。

title: Topological building blocks of nonequilibrium response
summary: Nonequilibrium systems can exploit energy to amplify their sensitivity to external stimuli, allowing them to be harnessed for a variety of functions in both engineered devices and living organisms. An assortment of theoretical results capture different facets of this nonequilibrium amplification, including fluctuation-response relations as well as bounds and constraints that limit the potential behavior. Here, we take a broader perspective, aiming for a systematic characterization of the full range of possible response behaviors. For a wide class of nonequilibrium dynamics, we identify a collection of optimally sensitive models whose behavior is determined by the topology of the state space. We further conjecture that every response can be written as a convex combination of these optimal models, thereby structuring the entire space of responses. We use this geometric perspective to put sensitivity limits on nonmonotonic biochemical input-output functions, and identify all optimal kinetic schemes for the unordered binding of molecules among three sites.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地刻画了非平衡系统响应行为的完整范围，发现了一类由状态空间拓扑决定的最优敏感模型，并推测所有响应都可表示为这些最优模型的凸组合，从而构建了整个响应空间的结构。
AI.motivation: 非平衡系统能够利用能量放大对外部刺激的敏感性，在工程设备和生物体中都有重要应用。现有理论虽分别捕捉了非平衡放大的不同方面，但缺乏对可能响应行为的系统性刻画。
AI.method: 作者采取更广泛的视角，对于一大类非平衡动力学，识别出一组由状态空间拓扑决定的最优敏感模型，并提出所有响应都可以表示为这些最优模型的凸组合这一猜想。
AI.result: 利用这种几何视角，作者对非单调的生化输入-输出函数设定了灵敏度极限，并识别出三个位点间无序结合分子的所有最优动力学方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解非平衡系统的响应行为提供了统一的理论框架，通过几何结构来组织整个响应空间，有助于指导工程设计和理解生物系统的功能。

title: Analytical solution of the Eliashberg equations for strong-coupling superconductivity in hydrides
comment: Accepted for publication in Annals of Physics. To appear in Annals of Physics (2026). DOI: 10.1016/j.aop.2026.170637
summary: The recent discovery of room-temperature superconductivity in hydrogen-rich materials under extreme pressures has renewed interest in phonon-mediated pairing mechanisms described by the Eliashberg theory, which generalizes the BCS framework by incorporating phonon retardation effects. In this article, we present an analytical solution to the isotropic Eliashberg equations for the superconducting critical temperature, formulated within the Debye model. This solution exhibits good agreement with fully selfconsistent numerical calculations across both weak- and strong-coupling regimes, correctly reproducing the exponential and square-root dependences on the electron-phonon coupling parameter. We further apply the solution to YH6, benchmarking against experiment and the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula. More broadly, across a diverse set of hydride superconductors, the predicted critical temperature shows scaling consistency with ab initio calculations and experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文在Debye模型框架下给出了各向同性Eliashberg方程的解析解，用于预测超导临界温度，该解在弱耦合和强耦合区域均与数值计算结果吻合，并在YH6等多种氢化物超导体中与实验和第一性原理计算具有标度一致性。
AI.motivation: 室温超导在富氢材料中被发现，但现有Eliashberg理论主要依赖数值计算，缺乏简洁的解析表达式，不利于理论分析和实际预测。
AI.method: 在Debye模型下对各向同性Eliashberg方程进行解析求解，并通过与完全自洽数值计算的对比验证其准确性。
AI.result: 解析解在弱耦合和强耦合区域均与数值计算吻合，正确再现了电子-声子耦合参数的指数和平方根依赖关系；在YH6等氢化物超导体中，预测的临界温度与实验和第一性原理计算一致。
AI.conclusion: 该解析解为理解和预测氢化物超导体的临界温度提供了简洁而准确的理论工具，弥补了纯数值方法的不足。

title: Analytical and numerical solutions to the non-diffusive Stefan problem
summary: In this work, the Maxwell--Cattaneo--Vernotte (MCV) equation is used to model the one-dimensional hyperbolic Stefan problem in the limit of a small Stefan number (Ste $\ll$ 1). The solutions are approximated with perturbation series expansions using a reformulation in which time is expressed as a function of the solid-liquid interface position. The first proposed solution is derived in a framework that considers diffusive heat transfer at the phase change interface, for analytic tractability. Two rectification strategies are proposed to address the asymptotic divergence present in this formulation: a rescaled inner solution which is then combined with the outer solution to yield a composite solution, and size-dependent thermo-physical system parameters for better capture of hyperbolic effects at the phase change interface. The resulting interface profiles exhibit a characteristic parabolic-like shape, consistent with diffusive Stefan problem findings, with pronounced early-time hyperbolic effects at larger thermal relaxation times. Parametric studies are done over three pertinent variables in the dimensionless system: the Stefan number ($\mathrm{Ste}$), the dimensionless thermal relaxation time ($\widetilde τ$), and the thermal diffusivity ($α$). The studies suggest that model error scales with the Stefan number in accordance with the theoretical truncation error of the perturbation expansion. Additionally, larger values of $\widetilde τ$ amplify early-time hyperbolic effects, thereby increasing model error, while larger $α$ extends the relative temporal domain over which these hyperbolic effects remain significant, also corresponding to an increase in model error.

AI.tldr: 本文利用MCV方程建模一维双曲Stefan问题（小Stefan数情形），通过摄动级数展开和界面位置-时间重构求解。针对渐近发散提出两种修正策略：内-外解复合方案与尺寸相关热物性方案。结果表明界面呈抛物型轮廓，热弛豫时间越大早时双曲效应越显著。模型误差随Stefan数、弛豫时间和热扩散率增大而增加。
AI.motivation: 在Stefan数极小（Ste≪1）的极限下，使用MCV方程（而非经典傅里叶热传导）建模一维双曲Stefan问题，以捕捉相变过程中的非傅里叶（双曲）热传导效应。
AI.method: 采用摄动级数展开方法求解，将时间重新表示为固-液界面位置的函数。提出两种针对渐近发散问题的修正策略：(1) 重缩放内解并与外解组合得到复合解；(2) 引入尺寸依赖的热物理参数以更好捕捉界面处的双曲效应。
AI.result: 界面轮廓呈特征抛物型（与扩散Stefan问题一致），较大热弛豫时间下早时双曲效应更明显。模型误差随Stefan数按摄动截断误差理论缩放，随弛豫时间τ̃增大而增大（早时双曲效应放大），随热扩散率α增大而增大（双曲效应相对时间域延长）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的修正策略能有效处理双曲Stefan问题中的渐近发散，模型误差来源包括Stefan数、弛豫时间和热扩散率三个无量纲参数，为双曲相变传热建模提供了分析框架和误差评估依据。

title: Core-excited and shape-type resonances in the micro-solvated Uracil: A CASSCF study
summary: Electronic resonances play an important role in electron attachment-induced processes in biomolecules, and their properties can be significantly influenced by the local molecular environment. Here, we investigate the effect of amino acid micro-solvation on the uracil resonances by employing uracil-glycine as a model system. The resonance spectrum of the uracil-glycine complex consists of four π-type shape resonances and three core-excited resonances, including an additional glycine-centered resonance, as characterized using the CASSCF/Resonance via Padé (RVP) methodology. Comparison with isolated uracil and the uracil(ghostGly) model shows that explicit interaction with glycine stabilizes both the shape and core-excited resonances by lowering their energies and increasing their lifetimes, while the ghost calculations demonstrate that basis-set extension alone cannot account for the observed stabilization. The core-excited resonances exhibit states that retain non-negligible lifetimes despite their much higher energy, suggesting that they may play an important role in electron-induced dissociation pathways. Overall, the present results demonstrate that amino acid micro-solvation significantly modifies the resonance landscape of uracil, highlighting the importance of explicitly accounting for local biomolecular interactions in theoretical studies of electron attachment.

AI.tldr: 本文以尿嘧啶-甘氨酸复合物为模型，采用CASSCF/RVP方法研究氨基酸微溶剂化对尿嘧啶电子共振的影响。结果显示微溶剂化稳定了形状共振和核激发共振，降低能量、延长寿命，且核激发共振具有不可忽略的寿命，可能影响电子诱导解离路径。
AI.motivation: 电子共振在生物分子的电子附着过程中起重要作用，而局部分子环境会显著影响其性质。现有研究缺乏对氨基酸微溶剂化如何具体影响尿嘧啶共振行为的认识。
AI.method: 以尿嘧啶-甘氨酸复合物为模型系统，使用CASSCF/Resonance via Padé (RVP)方法进行表征，并与孤立尿嘧啶及尿嘧啶(ghostGly)模型进行对比分析。
AI.result: 复合物包含4种π型形状共振和3种核激发共振（含一个甘氨酸中心共振）。与孤立尿嘧啶相比，甘氨酸微溶剂化降低了共振能量并延长了寿命，且虚原子计算表明仅靠基组扩展无法解释这种稳定化效应。核激发共振在高能量下仍保持不可忽略的寿命。
AI.conclusion: 氨基酸微溶剂化显著改变了尿嘧啶的共振谱图，理论研究中必须明确考虑局部生物分子相互作用才能准确描述电子附着过程。

title: Symmetry-Twisted Multi-Entropies: Order Parameters for 2D SPT Phases
summary: Although symmetry-protected topological phases (SPTs) can be distinguished by their entanglement properties, it has been unclear how to extract this information directly from expectation values beyond the 1D case. Here, we close this gap and propose a pair of nonlocal order parameters that can detect and distinguish all bosonic SPTs in 2D protected by internal discrete, Abelian unitary symmetries. The desired topological invariants are extracted by these quantities by effectively simulating the SPT path integral on topologically non-trivial spacetime manifolds. Our order parameters are defined in terms of expectation values of partial symmetry and permutation operations acting on fixed numbers of replicas of the system in finite spatial regions. These expectation values correspond to symmetry-twisted versions of multipartite entanglement quantities known as multi-entropies. We show explicitly that our two order parameters detect symmetry-protected four-party and six-party entanglement, respectively, and we constrain possible "spurious" contributions. We analytically test our proposal in fixed-point lattice models. Our results suggest multipartite entanglement to be a defining feature of SPTs; indeed, we expect our methods to generalize to fermionic and higher-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两个非局域序参量，能够通过多体纠缠检测和区分二维玻色子对称保护拓扑相（SPTs），通过模拟拓扑非平凡时空流形上的路径积分实现。
AI.motivation: 虽然SPTs可以通过纠缠性质区分，但在二维及更高维度中，如何直接从期望值中提取这些信息一直不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出两个非局域序参量，定义在有限空间区域中系统副本上的部分对称操作和置换操作的期望值，对应于对称扭曲版本的多部分纠缠量（多熵），有效模拟了SPT路径积分。
AI.result: 两个序参量分别检测到对称保护的四体和六体纠缠，并限制了可能的“虚假”贡献；在固定点格点模型上分析验证了该方案。
AI.conclusion: 多部分纠缠是SPTs的 defining 特征；该方法有望推广到费米子体系和更高维系统。

title: Coordination-Resolved Surrogate Models for Thermodynamic Stability, Band Gaps, and Magnetic Moments of Spinel Oxides, Sulfides, and Selenides
summary: We curated 320 cubic ($Fd\bar{3}m$) spinel entries from the Materials Project-nitrides, oxides, sulfides, and selenides, including single-cation mixed-valence $A_3X_4$ compounds-and trained tree-ensemble surrogates for the formation energy, energy above the convex hull, band gap, total magnetization, and metallicity. Cations were assigned to tetrahedral-like and octahedral-like groups from CrystalNN coordination numbers rather than from element identity, and the evaluation was group-aware throughout: splits were grouped by reduced formula, every transform was fit on training folds only, and champion models were selected on cross-validated scores before the holdout was examined. Over twenty repeated grouped holdouts (single-seed refits that reuse the tuned hyperparameters, and are therefore mildly optimistic) the champions reach mean absolute errors of $0.121\pm0.030$ eV/atom for the formation energy, $0.048\pm0.013$ eV/atom for the hull distance, and $1.27\pm0.19$~\muBfu{} for the magnetization, with a metallicity accuracy of $0.85\pm0.06$. Band-gap regression does not beat a trivial baseline on the 19-member non-metal holdout under paired bootstrap testing, we report this negative result and trace it to sample scarcity and to the semi-local DFT labels. On the identical grouped split, the tabular champion is more accurate than an untuned MEGNet trained from scratch (0.087 versus 0.209 eV/atom formation-energy MAE on the primary holdout), a comparison that bounds, rather than settles, the descriptor-versus-graph question at this data scale. SHAP attribution ties the magnetization model to octahedral $d$-occupancy and the formation-energy and band-gap models to electronegativity descriptors, and grouped conformal intervals, permutation nulls, and leave-one-chemistry-out tests bound a domain of applicability that is uneven across anions and cations.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了320个尖晶石结构数据集的树集成代理模型，系统评估了形成能、凸包能量、带隙、磁化强度和金属性等性质，通过分组验证、SHAP归因和适用域分析，揭示了模型在不同阴离子和阳离子上的表现差异，并报告了带隙回归的负结果。
AI.motivation: 针对尖晶石材料（氮化物、氧化物、硫化物、硒化物）缺乏系统机器学习代理模型的问题，旨在通过树集成方法高效预测多种关键性质，并严格评估模型在化学多样性数据上的泛化能力与适用范围。
AI.method: 从Materials Project中筛选320个尖晶石样本，利用CrystalNN配位数将阳离子分为四面体/八面体组；训练树集成模型（形成能、凸包能量、带隙、磁化强度、金属性）；采用分组交叉验证（按简化化学式分组）、重复分组留出法评估；与MEGNet对比；使用SHAP归因、共形预测区间、置换检验和留一化学式检验分析模型可靠性和适用域。
AI.result: 形成能MAE 0.121±0.030 eV/atom，凸包距离MAE 0.048±0.013 eV/atom，磁化强度MAE 1.27±0.19 μB/f.u.，金属性准确率0.85±0.06；带隙回归未超越平凡基线（19个非金属样本）；树集成模型在相同分组下优于从头训练的MEGNet（0.087 vs 0.209 eV/atom）。
AI.conclusion: 树集成代理模型在尖晶石材料性质预测上表现良好，但带隙预测受限于样本稀缺和DFT标签质量；模型适用域在不同阴离子和阳离子间分布不均；该研究为描述符方法与图神经网络在有限数据规模下的比较提供了边界参考。

title: From stable periodic orbits to many-body chaos: doubly tunable prethermalization via engineering of an emergent band structure
summary: We uncover a family of many-body periodic orbits in a periodically driven (Floquet) spin system away from the high-frequency limit. While linear stability analysis predicts that perturbed many-body trajectories remain close to stable periodic orbits, thermodynamic principles dictate that Floquet heating will ultimately set in. Our work aims to resolve the tension between these two expectations. In particular, we show that perturbations away from the stable periodic orbits feature a description akin to a quasiparticle band structure. A long-lived prethermal regime appears when modes around the gapless point are slowly populated. The dispersion determines the prethermal lifetime, and we show how band engineering leads to a "doubly tunable" parametric dependence of the prethermal lifetime $R^{-W}$, with $R$ the width in momentum space of the quasiparticle distribution and $W$ the exponent of the dispersion around the gapless point. Our results not only establish a powerful route toward stabilizing non-equilibrium phases of matter in driven many-body systems but also establish a conceptual bridge between periodic orbits in 'low-dimensional' nonlinear systems and many-body chaos.

AI.tldr: 本文在周期驱动（Floquet）自旋系统中发现了一族多体周期轨道，揭示了线性稳定性分析与热力学加热预期之间的张力。研究表明，对稳定周期轨道的扰动具有类似准粒子能带结构的描述，通过能带工程可实现预热稳寿命的“双重可调”参数依赖关系（R^{-W}），为非平衡物态的稳定化建立了新途径，并架起了低维非线性周期轨道与多体混沌之间的概念桥梁。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在解决周期驱动多体系统中线性稳定性分析（预测扰动轨迹接近稳定周期轨道）与热力学预期（Floquet加热最终必然发生）之间的矛盾，理解预热稳态的机制并探索延长其寿命的方法。
AI.method: 通过分析远离高频极限的周期驱动自旋系统中的多体周期轨道，利用线性稳定性分析描述扰动行为，并引入类似准粒子能带结构的理论框架，研究色散关系对预热寿命的影响。通过能带工程实现对预热寿命的参数调控。
AI.result: 发现扰动具有准粒子能带结构；预热寿命由能带色散决定，存在R^{-W}形式的“双重可调”参数依赖关系（R为准粒子动量空间分布宽度，W为能带色散指数）。
AI.conclusion: 建立了稳定非平衡物态的新途径，并连接了低维非线性系统中的周期轨道与多体混沌现象，为理解驱动多体系统的预热稳态提供了统一框架。

title: Systematic modulation of superconducting gap dynamics in YBCO|BNT|YBCO Josephson Junctions through THz field interaction and BNT ferroelectric barrier
summary: The integration of ferroelectric barriers into high-temperature Josephson junctions offers a pathway to tunable superconducting quantum devices. Here, we demonstrate robust Josephson coupling in YBa2Cu3O7-x (YBCO)/Bi0.5Na0.5TiO3 (BNT)/YBCO trilayer junctions incorporating a 40 nm ferroelectric BNT barrier. Epitaxial trilayers were fabricated by pulsed laser deposition on SrTiO3 substrates and investigated under broadband terahertz (THz) irradiation (0.5-2.5 THz). At 1.5 THz, close to the Josephson plasma resonance, the BNT polarization increased from 33.4 to 46.4 uC/cm2 at 30 K, enhancing superconducting transport. The junctions exhibited a well-defined zero-voltage supercurrent branch, with the critical current Ic(T) remaining nearly constant up to 60 K and reaching 468.2 uA under 1.5 THz excitation, evidencing strong phase coherence. Scanning tunneling spectroscopy revealed an enhanced superconducting gap in YBCO/BNT/YBCO (Delta = 1.3 meV) compared with pure YBCO (Delta = 1.05 meV), while optical conductivity measurements showed a reduction in conductivity and gap with increasing temperature, consistent with BCS theory under THz excitation. Atomic force microscopy and X-ray reflectivity confirmed uniform morphology and sharp interfaces, excluding defect-mediated transport. Magnetic field modulation of Ic(B) exhibited a canonical Fraunhofer interference pattern, and resistance mapping revealed alternating lobes of high and low dissipation, indicating coherent Josephson tunneling. These results establish that Josephson coupling is intrinsic to the YBCO/BNT/YBCO junctions, enabled by the dipolar character and dynamic THz response of the BNT barrier. This study identifies BNT as a viable, tunable barrier material for next-generation high-Tc superconducting quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文在YBCO/BNT/YBCO三层约瑟夫森结中实现了铁电BNT势垒（40 nm）与高温超导的集成，展示了太赫兹辐照下增强的超导输运和相干约瑟夫森隧穿，证明了BNT作为可调势垒材料用于下一代高温超导量子器件的可行性。
AI.motivation: 将铁电势垒集成到高温约瑟夫森结中，以实现可调谐的超导量子器件，探索新型势垒材料BNT的可行性。
AI.method: 采用脉冲激光沉积在SrTiO3衬底上制备YBCO/BNT/YBCO外延三层结构，在宽带太赫兹辐照（0.5-2.5 THz）下进行表征，结合扫描隧道谱、光学电导率测量、原子力显微镜、X射线反射率及磁调制等手段分析结的性能。
AI.result: 1.5 THz下BNT极化从33.4增至46.4 uC/cm²（30 K），临界电流达468.2 uA并保持到60 K；超导能隙从1.05 meV增至1.3 meV；光学电导率随温度升高降低；观察到标准的夫琅禾费干涉图样和交替的高低耗散 lobes，证实相干约瑟夫森隧穿。
AI.conclusion: 约瑟夫森耦合是YBCO/BNT/YBCO结的本征特性，由BNT势垒的偶极特性和动态太赫兹响应实现，BNT是一种可行的可调势垒材料，适用于下一代高温超导量子器件。

title: Engineering Two-Dimensional Hybrid-Order Topological Insulators via Trilayer Coupling
summary: We propose an interlayer-engineering scheme to realize a two-dimensional hybrid-order topological insulator, characterized by the coexistence of first-order and second-order topological phases, in a coupled trilayer Chern system. Starting from three quantum anomalous Hall layers with Chern numbers $\mathcal{C}_{1/2/3}=+1/-1/+1$ in the decoupled limit, interlayer tunneling hybridizes their edge states into a single chiral edge mode, while simultaneously opening a gap that supports corner states. Consequently, the system exhibits the coexistence of one-dimensional chiral edge states and zero-dimensional corner states within the same bulk gap, a hallmark of the hybrid-order topology. Furthermore, we map out the topological phase diagram, and show that the hybrid-order phase is robust against mass-type disorder. Our results identify interlayer hybridization as a minimal and broadly applicable strategy for engineering coexisting edge and corner states within a topological platform.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出通过层间工程在耦合三层的陈系统中实现二维混合阶拓扑绝缘体，同时具有一阶（手性边缘态）和二阶（角态）拓扑相，并验证了其鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在单一体系中实现不同阶数拓扑相的共存（即混合阶拓扑绝缘体），探索层间耦合作为一种最小且普适的策略来工程化共存的边缘态和角态。
AI.method: 从三个陈数分别为+1/-1/+1的量子反常霍尔层出发，通过层间隧穿耦合将边缘态杂化，打开体带隙并同时产生角态，构建混合阶拓扑相。通过拓扑相图及质量型无序下的稳定性分析验证方案。
AI.result: 实现了在一维手性边缘态和零维角态在同一体带隙中共存；绘出了拓扑相图；证明了混合阶相对质量型无序具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 层间杂化是一种实现边缘态与角态共存的最小且普适的策略，为在拓扑平台上工程化混合阶拓扑相提供了新途径。

title: Strong-Field Coulomb Explosion of Ethane, Propane, and Butane in Circularly Polarized Laser Fields
summary: We investigate the Coulomb explosion of ethane (C$_2$H$_6$), propane (C$_3$H$_8$), and \textit{n}-butane (C$_4$H$_{10}$) driven by intense circularly polarized laser pulses using real-time time-dependent density functional theory (RT-TDDFT). The ionization dynamics are benchmarked against those obtained with linearly polarized fields oriented along the $x$, $y$, and $z$ axes at the same peak intensity. Under the laser conditions considered here, circular polarization produces greater ionization than any of the linearly polarized configurations for all three molecules, indicating that the rotating electric field enhances the initial electron-removal stage that triggers Coulomb explosion. Using circularly polarized excitation, we systematically characterize fragmentation thresholds, product distributions, channel branching ratios, and bond-breaking dynamics across the alkane series. Atomic hydrogen is the most abundant fragment in all three systems, demonstrating that hydrogen loss is the dominant fragmentation pathway. Ethane primarily retains its two-carbon backbone through partial dehydrogenation, propane exhibits the broadest range of fragmentation channels and the strongest competition between C--H and C--C bond cleavage within the present ensemble, and butane favors backbone cleavage into relatively stable two-carbon fragments, most notably through the $2\mathrm{C_2H_4} + 2\mathrm{H}$ channel. Analysis of the earliest bond-breaking events further shows that C--H dissociation is the preferred initial fragmentation step throughout the series, although the degree of competition with C--C cleavage depends on molecular size.

AI.tldr: 本文利用实时含时密度泛函理论(RT-TDDFT)研究了圆偏振强激光脉冲驱动下乙烷、丙烷和正丁烷的库仑爆炸过程。发现圆偏振比线偏振产生更强的电离，氢原子是主要碎片，且不同烷烃展示了不同的碎裂路径和通道竞争机制。
AI.motivation: 探究圆偏振强激光脉冲下烷烃分子的库仑爆炸动力学，理解旋转电场对电离和碎裂过程的影响，以及不同碳链长度分子在碎裂路径上的差异。
AI.method: 采用实时含时密度泛函理论(RT-TDDFT)模拟圆偏振和线偏振强激光脉冲驱动下乙烷、丙烷和正丁烷的库仑爆炸动力学，比较电离效率、碎片分布、通道分支比和键断裂动力学。
AI.result: (1) 圆偏振比线偏振产生更强的电离；(2) 氢原子是最主要的碎片；(3) 乙烷保持双碳骨架通过部分脱氢，丙烷碎裂通道最多且C-H与C-C竞争最激烈，丁烷倾向于碎裂为稳定的两个碳碎片(2C2H4+2H)；(4) C-H键断裂是初始碎裂的首选步骤，但竞争程度与分子大小相关。
AI.conclusion: 圆偏振激光能增强烷烃分子的初始电离，促进库仑爆炸；不同碳链长度的烷烃展示了差异化的碎裂路径；C-H键断裂始终占主导，但C-C键断裂的竞争随分子增大而增强。

title: Mapping vortices to anyons in toric code phases of generalized Kitaev models
summary: We present a comprehensive theory of mapping flux excitations, or vortices, to electric and magnetic particles in the toric code phases of generalizations of the Kitaev honeycomb model in two spatial dimensions. Our method, which is formulated with the Majorana fermion representation, utilizes the fusion rule of the Abelian anyons and the physical constraint on the fermion parity, and applies to generic model parameters including any perturbative limit. Not only are we able to reproduce the known mapping scheme in the dimer limit, we also derive the conditions for the invariance of anyon species of individual vortices. We prove that the mapping of anyons is left unchanged by any continuous evolution of model parameters that does not close the fermion gap in both the vortex-free and two-vortex sectors, which enables precise demarcations between multiple regimes associated with different maps within a single phase characterized by a trivial Chern number. We illustrate our theory via extensive computations for a number of selected models, in particular those defined on the square-octagon lattice and the honeycomb lattice with a Kekulé structure. We also demonstrate that distinct mappings of anyons can nevertheless exhibit the same weak symmetry breaking, and further argue that they belong to the same symmetry-enriched topological order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了在二维Kitaev蜂巢格点模型的toric code相中，将涡旋激发映射为电粒子和磁粒子的完整理论，利用马约拉纳费米子表示和任意子融合规则，证明了在费米子能隙不闭合的条件下映射保持不变，并区分了同一相内不同映射区域。
AI.motivation: 作者希望建立一种普适的方法，将广义Kitaev蜂巢模型中的涡旋激发（通量激发）映射为电粒子和磁粒子，解决现有方法仅适用于特定极限（如二聚化极限）的问题，并探究任意子种类在不同参数区域下的不变性条件。
AI.method: 采用马约拉纳费米子表示，结合阿贝尔任意子的融合规则和费米子宇称的物理约束，建立涡旋→电/磁粒子的映射理论。通过证明在无涡旋和双涡旋扇区中费米子能隙不闭合的条件下映射不变，来区分不同映射区域。在方-八角格子和具有Kekulé结构的蜂巢格子上进行了大量数值计算验证。
AI.result: 成功复现了已知的二聚化极限映射方案，推导出了单个涡旋任意子种类不变的条件。证明了只要在无涡旋和双涡旋扇区中费米子能隙不闭合，任意子映射在参数连续演化下保持不变。在多个模型上通过数值计算验证了理论。发现不同的任意子映射可以表现出相同的弱对称性破缺。
AI.conclusion: 不同的任意子映射可以属于相同的对称性富集的拓扑序（SET序），这为理解和分类拓扑相中涡旋激发的映射行为提供了统一的理论框架。

title: Hyperfine Structure and Exchange Coupling of Vacancy-Induced Ce$^{3+}$ Spin Centers in Nuclear-Spin-Dilute CeO$_2$
summary: Oxygen vacancies in ceria CeO$_2$ donate electrons that localize as Ce$^{3+}$ ($4f^1$, $S=1/2$) small polarons, creating rare-earth spin centers through native defect chemistry rather than implantation or extrinsic doping. We investigate the magnetic environment of these centers using first-principles PBE$+U$ calculations with a linear-response Hubbard parameter ($U=5.8382$ eV), hyperfine tensors from the all-electron reconstruction of the projector-augmented-wave method, and Korringa-Kohn-Rostoker exchange calculations within the coherent-potential approximation. Four vacancy configurations spanning concentrations from $3.125\%$ to $12.5\%$ are considered. A distinctive feature of the host follows from cerium isotopics: all naturally occurring cerium isotopes possess nuclear spin $I=0$, eliminating on-site hyperfine interactions at the Ce$^{3+}$ center and leaving the nuclear-spin bath entirely on the oxygen sublattice, whose sole magnetic isotope, $^{17}O$ ($I=5/2$), occurs at $0.038\%$ natural abundance. The resulting $^{17}O$ hyperfine landscape consists of a small number of strongly coupled, nearly axial first-shell nuclei with contact couplings reaching $6$~MHz, surrounded by a weakly coupled and strongly anisotropic outer shell. These tensors define experimentally accessible signatures for $^{17}O$ ESEEM and HYSCORE measurements and provide the microscopic hyperfine parameters required for cluster-correlation-expansion calculations of spin coherence. Exchange interactions between neighboring polarons are weak and oxygen-mediated, leaving the vacancy-generated spins largely independent over the concentration range considered. Together, these results establish oxygen-deficient CeO$_2$ as a chemically generated and intrinsically nuclear-spin-dilute host for rare-earth spin centers, and provide the first-principles magnetic parameters needed to assess their coherence properties.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，系统研究了氧空位在二氧化铈(CeO₂)中产生的Ce³⁺自旋中心的磁环境，揭示了其独特的超精细相互作用特征和交换耦合性质，并证明该材料是一种天然的、核自旋稀释的稀土自旋中心宿主。
AI.motivation: 利用氧空位而非掺杂或注入的方式在CeO₂中产生稀土自旋中心，研究其磁环境特性，探索这种"本征缺陷化学"途径是否能为自旋量子比特提供有利的相干环境。
AI.method: 采用PBE+U第一性原理计算（线性响应U=5.8382 eV），结合全电子重构PAW方法计算超精细张量，以及基于相干势近似的KKR交换计算，考虑了四种氧空位浓度（3.125%-12.5%）。
AI.result: 发现了独特的同位素特征：所有天然Ce同位素核自旋均为0，消除了Ce³⁺中心处的原位超精细相互作用；核自旋浴完全位于氧亚晶格上，唯一的磁活性同位素¹⁷O（I=5/2）仅占天然丰度的0.038%。¹⁷O超精细结构由少量强耦合近轴第一壳层核（接触耦合达6 MHz）和弱耦合强各向异性外壳层组成。相邻极化子间交换相互作用弱且通过氧介导。
AI.conclusion: 氧缺陷CeO₂是一种化学方法生成的、天然核自旋稀疏的稀土自旋中心宿主，该工作提供了评估其自旋相干性所需的第一性原理磁参数。

title: A Gaussian-Remainder Hierarchy for Sums of Random Variables with Big-Jump Statistics
summary: We develop an exact Gaussian-remainder hierarchy for the probability density of the sum of $N$ independent, identically distributed random variables with broad, finite-variance distribution for the summands. The hierarchy separates the Gaussian fixed-point contribution from residual sectors that retain the original single-summand density. For subexponential densities, the first nontrivial truncation yields a simple finite-$N$ approximation that involves one convolution with a Gaussian background and a subtraction that removes Gaussian overcounting. This approximation captures the Gaussian center, the crossover region, and the big-jump tail within a single expression, as demonstrated numerically for stretched-exponential and finite-variance power-law examples. The same first-order approximation reproduces the known asymptotic anomalous rate function for sums of stretched-exponential random variables and also provides an accurate approximation to the corresponding finite-$N$ rate function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个精确的高斯-残差层级，用于描述独立同分布有限方差随机变量之和的概率密度，将高斯固定点贡献与保留原始单变量密度的残差部分分离。一阶截断得到一个简单的有限N近似，能统一描述高斯中心、交叉区域和大跳尾，并在拉伸指数和有限方差幂律示例中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 对于具有宽尾但有限方差的独立同分布随机变量之和，经典中心极限定理描述高斯中心，但无法刻画尾部行为和有限N效应。作者希望发展一个统一框架，同时描述高斯中心、交叉区域和"大跳"尾部。
AI.method: 建立精确的高斯-残差层级（Gaussian-remainder hierarchy），将和分布分解为高斯固定点贡献与一系列残差项。一阶截断得到近似公式：一个高斯卷积项减去一项避免高斯过计数的修正项。
AI.result: 一阶近似能统一描述高斯中心、交叉区域和大跳尾；数值验证拉伸指数和有限方差幂律分布；准确复现拉伸指数和的渐近反常速率函数，并提供有限N速率函数的精确近似。
AI.conclusion: 该层级方法为有限方差宽尾随机变量和提供了超越经典CLT的统一近似工具，特别适用于从中心到尾部的完整分布刻画。

title: Pokrovsky--Talapov and Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless Phase Transitions in Bilayer Superconducting Films under an In-Plane Magnetic Field
summary: We study finite-temperature phase transitions in a Josephson-coupled bilayer superconducting film with compact layer phases under an in-plane magnetic field. At zero temperature, where thermally excited layer vortices are absent, the relative-phase sector undergoes a Pokrovsky--Talapov (PT) commensurate--incommensurate (C--IC) transition from a commensurate Fulde--Ferrell (C/FF) state to an incommensurate Bloch superconducting (IC/Bloch SC) state. At finite temperature, compactness separates two distinct defect mechanisms. The C--IC boundary remains a PT soliton-entry line: interlayer Josephson vortex--antivortex-pair solitons enter with the square-root onset $ρ_{\rm sol}\propto [k_0-k_0^c(T)]^{1/2}$. Thermal melting is instead Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT)-like, with correlation exponent $η=1/4$ at the boundary, but the active vortex channel changes across the phase diagram. Josephson locking suppresses elementary layer vortices in the C/FF state and selects a same-vorticity layer-pair BKT channel, whereas elementary layer vortices control melting of the IC/Bloch SC state.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在面内磁场作用下，具有紧致层相位的约瑟夫森耦合双层超导薄膜的有限温度相变。零温时相对相位区经历Pokrovsky-Talapov (PT) 相变；有限温度下，紧致性分离出两种缺陷机制，相变边界是PT孤子进入线，而热熔化是BKT类型，但活跃涡旋通道随相图变化。
AI.motivation: 探究约瑟夫森耦合双层超导薄膜在面内磁场下有限温度的相变行为，特别是紧致层相位如何影响缺陷机制和相变性质。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，研究零温下相对相位区的PT C-IC转变，以及有限温度下紧致性导致的两种不同缺陷机制：PT孤子进入线和BKT热熔化。
AI.result: 零温时发生PT相变；有限温度下C-IC边界是PT孤子进入线（ρ_sol ∝ [k0 - k0^c(T)]^{1/2}），热熔化为BKT类型（η=1/4），但活跃涡旋通道在C/FF态和IC/Bloch SC态中不同。
AI.conclusion: 约瑟夫森锁定制制了C/FF态中的基本层涡旋，选择了同涡度层对BKT通道；而IC/Bloch SC态的熔化由基本层涡旋控制。

title: Quantum anomalous Hall effect with tunable Chern numbers induced by d-wave sublattice-staggered altermagnetism
summary: We construct a minimal spinful tight-binding model on a square lattice, where a $d$-wave sublattice-staggered altermagnetism drives the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Here the exchange field is staggered between the two sublattices, where it takes opposite signs on $A$ and $B$ described by the Pauli matrix $τ_z$. The resulting insulating phases host tunable Chern numbers $\mathcal{C}=\pm1$ and $\mathcal{C}=\pm2$, controlled by the staggered exchange strength and the sublattice-staggered potential. We determine the complete phase diagram, identify valley-resolved band inversions at the $X$ and $Y$ points in the Brillouin zone, and demonstrate chiral edge states together with quantized two-terminal conductance plateaus. Our work provides a simple route to realizing the quantum anomalous Hall effect in compensated magnets via a $d$-wave sublattice-staggered altermagnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文在正方晶格上构建了一个最小自旋ful紧束缚模型，利用d波子晶格交错的交替磁性驱动量子反常霍尔效应，实现了陈数可调（±1和±2）的绝缘相，并展示了手性边缘态和量子化电导平台。
AI.motivation: 探索在补偿磁体中通过d波子晶格交错的交替磁性实现量子反常霍尔效应的简单途径，无需传统铁磁序或强自旋轨道耦合。
AI.method: 构建最小自旋ful紧束缚模型，引入由泡利矩阵τ_z描述的子晶格交错交换场（交替磁序），通过调节交错交换强度和子晶格交错势，分析拓扑相图、能带反转及边缘态。
AI.result: 实现了陈数C=±1和±2的可调量子反常霍尔绝缘相；确定了完整相图；在布里渊区X和Y点识别出谷分辨的能带反转；展示了手性边缘态和量子化的两端电导平台。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种通过d波子晶格交错交替磁性在补偿磁体中实现量子反常霍尔效应的简洁路线，为拓扑物态研究开辟了新方向。

title: Measurement and assignment of $\it{J}$ $\geq$ 10 rotational energy levels in the 9510 to 9810 cm$^{-1}$ and 6590 to 6900 cm$^{-1}$ ranges of methane using optical frequency comb double-resonance spectroscopy
summary: Accurate models of high temperature methane spectra are needed in astrophysics. Previous measurements of methane hot-band transitions in the $\it{P}$6 $\leftarrow$ $\it{P}$2 polyad range have been limited to final rotational numbers of $\it{J}$ $\le$ 9, with theoretical predictions at higher $\it{J}$s remaining unvalidated. Here, we use optical-optical double resonance spectroscopy (OODR) with a 3.3 $μ$m narrow linewidth pump to excite the $ν$${_3}$ P(12, A${_1}$$^{(2)}$) methane transition ($\it{P}$2 $\leftarrow$ $\it{P}$0) and a cavity-enhanced frequency comb centered around 1.68 $μ$m to probe the sub-Doppler ladder-type ($\it{P}$6 $\leftarrow$ $\it{P}$2) and V-type ($\it{P}$4 $\leftarrow$ $\it{P}$0) transitions, as well as Doppler-broadened collision-induced four-level transitions ($\it{P}$6 $\leftarrow$ $\it{P}$2). 49 ladder-type transitions with final rotational states $\it{J}$ = 10-12 in the range of 9510 to 9810 cm$^{-1}$ (i.e., the $\it{P}$6 polyad) were assigned to effective Hamiltonian predictions and the ExoMol database, of which 6 reached vibrational states that had not been observed experimentally before. 19 sub-Doppler V-type transitions with final states $\it{J}$ = 11-13 in the range of 6590 to 6900 cm$^{-1}$ (i.e., the $\it{P}$4 polyad) were observed and assigned to the Hamiltonian and ExoMol, while only 2 of these V-type transitions could be unambiguously assigned to WKLMC and HITRAN line lists. 170 Doppler-broadened four-level double-resonance (4LDR) lines were observed, 7 of which were newly observed compared with our previous work when pumping transitions starting from the $\it{J}$ = 7 level in the ground state [Lehmann et al., J. Chem. Phys. 163, 144304 (2025)]. We could not assign these lines as they did not form combination differences with other observed 4LDR transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用光-光双共振光谱（OODR）结合3.3 μm窄线宽泵浦和1.68 μm频率梳探针，测量了甲烷高温光谱中P6←P2和P4←P0等跃迁，成功指认了49个梯式跃迁（J=10-12）、19个V型跃迁（J=11-13）和170个多普勒展宽四能级双共振线，其中6个梯式跃迁首次观测到先前未实验验证的振动能态。
AI.motivation: 天体物理学需要精确的高温甲烷光谱模型，但先前对甲烷热波段跃迁（P6←P2多聚体范围）的测量仅局限于J≤9，更高J值的理论预测未得到实验验证。
AI.method: 采用光-光双共振光谱（OODR），以3.3 μm窄线宽激光泵浦甲烷ν₃ P(12, A₁⁽²⁾)跃迁（P2←P0），再用1.68 μm腔增强频率梳探针，测量亚多普勒梯式跃迁（P6←P2）、V型跃迁（P4←P0）及多普勒展宽碰撞诱导四能级跃迁（P6←P2）。
AI.result: 指认49个梯式跃迁（J=10-12，9510-9810 cm⁻¹），其中6个达先前未观测的振动能态；观测19个亚多普勒V型跃迁（J=11-13，6590-6900 cm⁻¹），但仅2个在WKLMC和HITRAN清单中有明确指认；观测170个四能级双共振线，7个为新发现。
AI.conclusion: 成功扩展了甲烷高温光谱的测量范围至更高J值，验证了有效哈密顿量预测和ExoMol数据库，但部分跃迁在现有光谱清单（如WKLMC、HITRAN）中仍未被收录或明确指认，表明现有数据库在高J热波段覆盖方面有待完善。

title: Logarithmic corrections to bulk and surface criticality in a three-dimensional quantum Heisenberg antiferromagnet
summary: At the bulk upper critical dimension, marginally irrelevant interactions generate multiplicative logarithmic corrections to mean-field scaling. While these corrections are well understood for bulk observables, their consequences for boundary criticality, particularly for finite-size scaling, remain much less explored. Here we combine large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations with boundary renormalization-group analysis to study a (3 + 1)D O(3) quantum critical point. After verifying the known logarithmically modified bulk finite-size scaling, including the correlation-length scaling governed by the logarithmic finite-size exponent \hat{\coppa}, we tune the surface coupling to identify ordinary, special, and extraordinary boundary regimes. For the ordinary and special transitions, we derive logarithmic correction exponents and \hat{\coppa}-dependent finite-size scaling forms for boundary correlations, including results that have not been systematically established before. These predictions are quantitatively supported by Monte Carlo data. In the extraordinary regime, we find long-range surface magnetic order and a logarithmically enhanced surface-bulk correlation.

AI.tldr: 本文结合大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟与边界重正化群分析，研究了(3+1)维O(3)量子临界点，揭示了边界临界性中多重对数修正的有限尺寸标度行为，包括普通、特殊和非凡三种边界相变，并通过数值模拟验证了理论预言。
AI.motivation: 此前对体观测量（bulk observables）中的对数修正已有较好理解，但边界临界性（特别是有限尺寸标度）中的对数修正效应尚未被系统探索。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用大规模量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟结合边界重正化群（boundary RG）分析，系统地研究了(3+1)D O(3)量子临界点的边界有限尺寸标度行为。
AI.result: 验证了已知的对数修正体观有限尺寸标度（包括由对数有限尺寸指数\hat{\coppa}控制的相关长度标度）；识别了普通、特殊和非凡三种边界标度行为；推导了普通和特殊边界相变中的对数修正指数及\hat{\coppa}依赖的有限尺寸标度形式；在非凡相中观测到长程表面磁有序以及对数增强的表面-体关联。
AI.conclusion: 边界临界性的对数修正可以通过边界RG分析系统量化，且QMC模拟提供了定量支持。该工作拓展了对上临界维度边界临界现象的理解，并为更广泛的量子临界系统提供了分析框架。

title: Phase-Controlled Epitaxy and Anisotropic Antiferromagnetism of Polar Wurtzite MnTe
comment: main text pages 1-20, 6 figures; supplement pages 21-29, 5 figures
summary: Altermagnetic spintronics requires materials in which compensated magnetic order, symmetry-controlled electronic responses, and epitaxial tunability can be combined in experimentally accessible thin films. MnTe is a key material in this context, but experimental studies have focused mainly on the stable NiAs-type polymorph, whereas the polar wurtzite phase remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate molecular-beam epitaxy growth and investigate properties of nearly phase-pure wurtzite MnTe deposited directly on GaAs(111)B, and show that small changes in the growth conditions strongly modify the phase composition, from a multiphase state with endotaxial NiAs-type inclusions embedded in wurtzite MnTe matrix to an almost single-phase polar wurtzite layer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了纤锌矿相MnTe薄膜的分子束外延生长及其作为交变磁性材料的潜力，发现通过调控生长条件可实现从多相态到近单相极性纤锌矿层的转变。
AI.motivation: 交变磁性自旋电子学需要兼具补偿磁有序、对称性调控电子响应和外延可调性的材料，而MnTe的纤锌矿相（极性相）此前探索很少，因此有必要系统研究其生长和性质。
AI.method: 利用分子束外延技术在GaAs(111)B衬底上直接沉积近单相纤锌矿MnTe薄膜，通过改变生长条件调控相组成，并对其结构和性质进行表征。
AI.result: 成功实现了近单相极性纤锌矿MnTe薄膜的生长；生长条件的微小变化可显著影响相组成，从含有NiAs型内嵌夹杂的多相态转变为几乎纯相的纤锌矿层。
AI.conclusion: 纤锌矿MnTe是一种有潜力的交变磁性材料，其外延生长可控性为交变磁性自旋电子学提供了新的材料平台。

title: From phase space to Krylov space, one shell at a time
summary: In this work, we develop and study the classical Lanczos algorithm allowing us to define Krylov complexity using the symplectic structure of phase space: Poisson brackets take on the role of the quantum commutators and phase-space integrals furnish the inner product needed to define the Lanczos recursion. We show, using general methods of quantum mechanics in phase space, that the $\hbar \to 0$ limit of the usual quantum mechanical Krylov framework smoothly goes over into the classical one. In theories with well-defined semiclassical limits, we show that classical Krylov complexity accurately approximates quantum complexity at early enough times, and thus is a useful characteristic of early-time chaotic dynamics. We define a Krylov-Ehrenfest time, which quantifies the eventual divergence of classical and quantum complexities, corresponding to a characteristic depth of the Krylov chain, $n\sim n_*(\hbar)$, which in the time domain translates to the well-known scale, $t_*\simλ_K^{-1}\log(1/\hbar)$, in generic chaotic systems. We additionally define microcanonical Krylov complexities, both in the classical and quantum setting, which allows one a fine-grained study of complexity, energy shell by energy shell. We apply this framework to the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick (LMG) and Feingold-Peres (FP) models, which are collective spin systems known to classicalize in the thermodynamic limit. In particular, while the FP model features spectral chaos for some range of coupling values, the LMG model is known to exhibit early-time saddle-dominated scrambling. Our analysis shows that the instability in LMG is resolved by the microcanonical Krylov complexity, which is controlled by the integrable structure of the Hamiltonian in spectral windows away from the instability, both at early and late times.

AI.tldr: 本文发展并研究了基于辛相空间结构的经典Lanczos算法，定义了经典Krylov复杂度。证明了量子Krylov框架在$\hbar \to 0$极限下平滑过渡到经典框架，并提出了Krylov-Ehrenfest时间，量化了经典与量子复杂度在混沌系统中偏离的时间尺度。将框架应用于Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick（LMG）和Feingold-Peres（FP）模型，揭示了微正则Krylov复杂度对早期鞍点主导混沌的解析能力。
AI.motivation: 现有量子Krylov复杂度框架在$\hbar \to 0$极限下如何过渡到经典系统尚不清楚，经典混沌系统缺乏基于相空间辛结构的Krylov复杂度定义，且微正则层面对复杂度的精细分析不够充分。
AI.method: 利用经典相空间的Poisson括号代替量子对易子，以相空间积分构造内积，建立经典Lanczos算法；通过量子力学相空间方法（如Wigner-Weyl变换）证明$\hbar \to 0$极限下量子框架平滑过渡到经典框架；定义Krylov-Ehrenfest时间$t_*\sim\lambda_K^{-1}\log(1/\hbar)$；定义经典和量子微正则Krylov复杂度；应用于LMG和FP集体自旋模型。
AI.result: 经典Krylov复杂度在早期时间能准确近似量子复杂度，适用于描述早期混沌动力学；Krylov链深度$n\sim n_*(\hbar)$对应经典与量子偏离的时间尺度；在FP模型中验证了谱混沌，在LMG模型中微正则Krylov复杂度揭示了稳定的能量窗口（远离鞍点不稳定区）主导的积分结构，解决了LMG早期鞍点混沌的模糊性。
AI.conclusion: 经典Krylov复杂度是早期混沌动力学的有效工具，微正则Krylov复杂度提供了按能量壳层精细分析复杂度的新途径，特别适用于处理鞍点主导的量子混沌系统。

title: Magnetothermopower and particle-hole symmetry in a cuprate strange metal
summary: Here, we report magnetothermopower measurements on overdoped (Bi,Pb)2(Sr,La)2CuO6+delta (Bi2201) single crystals in magnetic fields up to 35 T. Whereas the temperature dependence of the zero-field Seebeck coefficient S(T) can be captured using Boltzmann transport theory, the field-dependent response S(H) cannot. Instead, the magnetothermopower contains a large additional contribution whose field and temperature dependence is consistent with the presence of short-range superconducting order well above Tc. Combined with earlier Hall and magnetoresistance results, these data imply that the overdoped cuprate strange metal contains two transport sectors with distinct particle-hole symmetry: a conventional particle-hole-asymmetric Fermi-liquid (FL) contribution governing the Hall effect and the zero-field thermopower, and a nearly particle-hole-symmetric sector dominating the anomalous longitudinal magnetotransport. We formulate a phenomenological real-space model in which disconnected FL islands are embedded in a compensated Dirac liquid of phase-incoherent d-wave Bogoliubov quasiparticles. This picture reconciles conventional zero-field transport with anomalous magnetothermopower and magnetoresistance and offers a concrete framework for thinking about strange metallicity in overdoped cuprates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过测量过掺杂Bi2201单晶在高磁场下的磁热电效应，发现反常的磁热电功率无法用玻尔兹曼输运理论解释，而应归因于Tc以上短程超导序的存在。结合霍尔效应和磁电阻结果，提出了一个包含两类输运通道的双流体模型：常规的费米液体部分与近似粒子-空穴对称的狄拉克液体部分，后者源于非相干d波Bogoliubov准粒子。
AI.motivation: 探究过掺杂铜氧化物高温超导体中"奇异金属"态的输运性质来源，特别是理解反常的磁热电效应是否与超导涨落或短程超导序有关。
AI.method: 对过掺杂(Bi,Pb)2(Sr,La)2CuO6+delta单晶进行高达35T的强磁场下的磁热电功率测量，对比零场Seebeck系数与磁场依赖响应，并结合霍尔效应和磁电阻数据进行综合分析，构建实空间唯象模型。
AI.result: 零场Seebeck系数可用玻尔兹曼输运理论描述，但磁场依赖的响应存在额外的大贡献；该贡献的温度和磁场依赖性与Tc以上的短程超导序一致；存在两个输运通道：常规粒子-空穴不对称的费米液体和近似粒子-空穴对称的狄拉克液体。
AI.conclusion: 过掺杂铜氧化物中存在两类输运通道：费米液体岛嵌入补偿的狄拉克液体中，后者由非相干d波Bogoliubov准粒子构成。该模型统一了常规零场输运与反常磁热电、磁电阻行为，为理解奇异金属态提供了具体框架。

title: Second-order topological insulator induced by compensated altermagnetism without bulk spin splitting
summary: We theoretically demonstrate a second-order topological insulating phase induced by compensated altermagnetism, while keeping the bulk gap unchanged, in a two-dimensional topological insulator film. By introducing a layer-resolved out-of-plane $d$-wave altermagnetic term with opposite signs on the top and bottom layers, the system preserves $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry and maintains spin degeneracy in the bulk bands, while simultaneously gapping the helical edge states and generating localized corner states. The resulting higher-order phase is characterized by nonzero mirror-graded winding numbers, and an effective edge theory shows that the corner states arise from Dirac mass domain walls. We further determine the phase boundaries analytically and construct the corresponding topological phase diagram, establishing a robust route to higher-order topology without bulk spin splitting.

AI.tldr: 该论文理论证明，在二维拓扑绝缘体薄膜中，通过补偿性交错磁（altermagnetism）可在保持体带隙不变的情况下诱导出二阶拓扑绝缘相，其特征为受保护的角态和非零镜面分级绕数。
AI.motivation: 探索在不依赖体自旋分裂的情况下实现高阶拓扑相的新机制，利用补偿性交错磁来产生受保护的角态。
AI.method: 在二维拓扑绝缘体薄膜中引入层分辨的面外d波交错磁项（顶层和底层符号相反），保持PT对称性和体带自旋简并，同时使螺旋边缘态打开能隙并产生局域角态。通过镜像分级绕数进行拓扑表征，并利用有效边缘理论将角态解释为狄拉克质量畴壁。
AI.result: 成功诱导出二阶拓扑绝缘相，确定了相边界，构建了拓扑相图，建立了无需体自旋分裂的高阶拓扑实现路径。
AI.conclusion: 补偿性交错磁为在不破坏体带自旋简并的条件下实现高阶拓扑绝缘体提供了稳健的理论方案，拓展了高阶拓扑物态的设计思路。

title: Emergent interweaved CDW unoccupied states in hole-doping LaTe2 with element substitution
summary: Multiple CDW-ordered layered rare-earth tellurides have increasingly emerged as a research hotspot, owing to their unconventional CDW formation, high transition temperature, and confirmed existence of axial Higgs modes. Recently, interweaved CDW in LaTe2 and its element-substituted phase LaTe2-xSbx have been investigated through TEM and ARPES measurements, revealing their distinct origins. Nevertheless, several complex diffraction features observed in TEM patterns remain unelucidated. In this work, we carried out scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) on LaTe1.6Sb0.4 crystals at 9 K. Three interweaved CDW wave vectors, q1=8/11a*, q2=5/11a* and q3=3/11a* were observed, which are induced by hole doping in unoccupied states. The q1 and q3 are theoretically verified to be nesting vectors connecting px- and py- bands. Furthermore, the satellite spots relative to the main Bragg spots p corresponding to a 11-a-superlattice have also been detected. Our findings provide critical insights for further exploring the origin of the interweaved CDW in hole/electron doping materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过STM扫描隧道显微镜在9K下观测LaTe1.6Sb0.4晶体，发现了三种交织的CDW波矢（q1=8/11a*, q2=5/11a*, q3=3/11a*），其中q1和q3经理论验证为连接px和py能带的嵌套矢量，并检测到对应11a超晶格的卫星斑点，为理解空穴/电子掺杂材料中交织CDW的起源提供了关键见解。
AI.motivation: 此前研究发现LaTe2及其元素替代相LaTe2-xSbx中存在交织CDW，但TEM图案中多种复杂的衍射特征尚未得到解释，因此需要更深入的实验探究。
AI.method: 使用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）在9K低温下对LaTe1.6Sb0.4晶体进行观测，并结合理论验证分析CDW波矢。
AI.result: 观测到三种交织CDW波矢q1=8/11a*、q2=5/11a*和q3=3/11a*，由未占据态中的空穴掺杂诱导；q1和q3被验证为连接px和py能带的嵌套矢量；同时检测到对应11a超晶格的卫星斑点。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为进一步探索空穴/电子掺杂材料中交织CDW的起源提供了重要见解。

title: Emergent toroidal induction in a polar Weyl ferromagnet
summary: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) underpins modern spintronics by enabling the electrical generation of spin torques. Its reciprocal counterpart, in which magnetization dynamics produce electromotive forces through a spin-dependent Berry phase, is known as emergent electromagnetic induction (EEMI). However, this effect has previously been observed only in magnetic textures with spatial gradients, such as domain walls, helices, and skyrmions. Here, we demonstrate that even a spatially uniform ferromagnet can host EEMI through a previously unrecognized Berry-phase mechanism inherent to noncentrosymmetric conductors. In the polar Weyl ferromagnet PrAlGe, an applied alternating current generates spin-orbit torques that drive collective magnetization dynamics. The resulting emergent toroidal moment (T = P \times M), where (P) is the crystal's polar axis and (M) is the net magnetization, acts as a gauge potential whose time derivative (dT/dt) induces a Hall voltage. This contribution appears specifically in the out-of-phase component of the AC Hall response and scales linearly with frequency, providing direct evidence for EEMI. First-principles calculations further reveal that this toroidal vector encodes the collective motion of Weyl nodes in momentum space. These findings establish "emergent toroidal induction" as a new manifestation of spin-orbit entanglement, unifying Berry phase, topology, and spin dynamics while opening a pathway toward intrinsic and energy-efficient spin-charge interconversion.

AI.tldr: 本文在极性Weyl铁磁体PrAlGe中发现了一种新型的涌现电磁感应(EEMI)机制——即使空间均匀的铁磁体也能通过非中心对称导体中此前未知的Berry相位机制产生EEMI。具体地，交变电流驱动自旋轨道力矩引起集体磁化动力学，产生的涌现环形矩T = P × M的时间导数dT/dt诱导出霍尔电压，这在外相位AC霍尔响应中表现为与频率线性相关的信号。
AI.motivation: 此前EEMI仅在具有空间梯度的磁纹理（如畴壁、螺旋磁结构、斯格明子）中被观察到。作者希望探索是否可以在空间均匀的铁磁体中实现EEMI，揭示一种新的Berry相位机制。
AI.method: 以极性Weyl铁磁体PrAlGe为研究对象，施加交变电流产生自旋轨道力矩驱动集体磁化动力学；通过测量AC霍尔响应的外相位分量来检测涌现环形矩诱导的霍尔电压；结合第一性原理计算验证环形矩与动量空间中Weyl节点集体运动的关联。
AI.result: 在空间均匀的PrAlGe中观测到了与频率线性相关的AC霍尔响应外相位分量，证实了EEMI的存在；第一性原理计算揭示了环形矩编码了Weyl节点在动量空间中的集体运动。
AI.conclusion: 建立了"涌现环形矩感应"作为自旋-轨道纠缠的新表现形式，统一了Berry相位、拓扑和自旋动力学，为内在且节能的自旋-电荷相互转换开辟了新途径。

title: Emergence of drifted diffusion in quantum walks with subspace restart
summary: Restart of a quantum process is typically modeled as a global reinitialization that erases the system's entire history. Here we introduce subspace restart, a protocol that periodically resets only the internal degrees of freedom while preserving the spatial distribution, as a tunable knob for the quantum-to-classical crossover. Using the discrete-time quantum walk as an example, we show that this selective reset drives the walker into an engineered drifted-diffusion regime. This phenomenon can be understood by a Huygens-Fresnel mechanism, where each restart fragments the wave function into a set of independent secondary sources to screen long-range correlations and isolate a robust classical backbone, whose drift and diffusivity are set by the geometric orientation of the initial coin and the restart period. Residual quantum interference, confined to effective light cones, survives only as a short-range correction that renormalizes these coefficients and imprints periodic modulations on the cumulants. Our results establish subspace restart as a route to controlling the quantum-to-classical crossover in synthetic lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出子空间重启协议，通过周期性仅重置量子系统的内部自由度而保留空间分布，实现了量子到经典过渡的可调控。以离散时间量子行走为例，该协议驱使行走者进入工程化漂移-扩散 regime，其机制可类比惠更斯-菲涅尔原理，最终建立了一种控制量子-经典交叉的路径。
AI.motivation: 传统量子过程重启会全局重新初始化，擦除系统全部历史。本文试图引入一种更精细的控制方式——仅重置内部自由度而保留空间分布，以此作为调控量子-经典过渡的旋钮。
AI.method: 提出子空间重启协议，周期性重置量子行走的内部自由度（硬币态），保留空间分布；利用离散时间量子行走作为模型系统分析该协议对动力学的影响。
AI.result: 子空间重启驱动行走者进入工程化漂移-扩散 regime；发现该现象可由惠更斯-菲涅尔机制解释——每次重启将波函数碎片化为独立次级源，屏蔽长程关联并提取出经典骨架；残余量子干涉被限制在有效光锥内，仅作为短程修正重新归一化系数并印刻周期调制。
AI.conclusion: 子空间重启提供了一条在合成晶格中控制量子-经典交叉的有效路径。

title: Fractionalized Fermi liquids with the ghost-Gutzwiller Ansatz
comment: 5 pages of main text with 2 figures, and 7 pages of supplemental material
summary: Fractionalized Fermi liquids ($\mathrm{FL}^{\!*}$), elusive metallic states characterized by fractionalized quasiparticles alongside conventional ones and defying Luttinger's theorem, are prime candidates for the pseudogap regime of underdoped cuprates. We show that a $\mathrm{FL}^{\!*}$ phase emerges in the single-band $t$-$J$ model through a simple ghost-Gutzwiller Ansatz, optimized at the cost of a mean-field calculation. The resulting temperature-doping phase diagram encompasses a low-doping $\mathrm{FL}^{\!*}$, a $d$-wave superconducting dome, and an overdoped conventional Fermi liquid, thereby reproducing key qualitative features of cuprate phenomenology.

AI.tldr: 本文通过鬼影-格茨维勒方法，在单带t-J模型中发现了分数化费米液体（FL*）相，其相图包含低掺杂FL*、d波超导穹顶和过掺杂常规费米液体，再现了铜氧化物高温超导体的关键特征。
AI.motivation: 分数化费米液体（FL*）是解释欠掺杂铜氧化物赝能隙态的重要候选理论，但其在简单模型中的理论实现仍有待探索。本文旨在证明FL*相可在单带t-J模型中通过简单方法自然产生。
AI.method: 采用鬼影-格茨维勒（ghost-Gutzwiller）变分Ansatz，在平均场层次优化计算，从而在单带t-J模型中实现FL*相。
AI.result: 成功发现FL*相，并构建出包含低掺杂FL*、d波超导穹顶和过掺杂常规费米液体的完整相图，定性复现了铜氧化物实验现象。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个描述铜氧化物赝能隙相的简洁理论框架，表明FL*态在强关联单带模型中可自然出现，对理解高温超导机理有重要意义。

title: Domain wall motion in ferromagnetic nanowires driven by a localized Gaussian thermal gradient
summary: We investigate magnetic domain wall (DW) dynamics in a uniaxial ferromagnetic nanowire under the localized Gaussian temperature profile of a laser spot using the stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation. The DW velocity increases linearly with peak laser temperature and decreases with increasing laser to DW distance. The velocity varies nonlinearly with Gilbert damping because damping strengthens thermal magnon excitation but shortens the magnon propagation length. The DW initially lies away from the laser-heated region, so the temperature gradient at its position is effectively zero and the entropic torque is negligible. The DW motion is therefore mainly driven by magnonic spin-transfer torque. We analyze laser temperature, laser to DW distance, damping, uniaxial anisotropy, and laser width. The analysis shows that laser width and laser to DW distance independently control the DW response. These findings may clarify the mechanism of localized thermally driven DW motion and guide thermal control strategies in spintronic racetrack-memory devices.

AI.tldr: 利用随机LLG方程研究单轴铁磁纳米线中局部激光加热驱动磁畴壁运动的机制，发现速度与峰值温度线性相关，主要由磁振子自旋转移矩驱动而非熵矩，激光宽度和距离可独立调控畴壁响应。
AI.motivation: 澄清局部热驱动磁畴壁运动的物理机制，为自旋电子赛道存储器中的热控制策略提供理论指导。
AI.method: 采用随机Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程，模拟单轴铁磁纳米线中在激光高斯温度剖面下的磁畴壁动力学，系统改变峰值温度、激光与畴壁距离、Gilbert阻尼、各向异性和激光宽度等参数进行分析。
AI.result: 畴壁速度随峰值温度线性增加，随激光-畴壁距离增加而减小；速度随阻尼变化呈非线性（因热磁振子激发与传播长度竞争）；驱动机制主要是磁振子自旋转移矩，熵矩可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 激光宽度和激光-畴壁距离可独立控制畴壁响应，该发现有助于理解局部热驱动畴壁运动的机理，并指导赛道存储器的热管理策略。

title: Giant magnetocaloric effect at low fields in triangular-lattice NdMgAl$_{11}$O$_{19}$
summary: Magnetic refrigeration in the sub-Kelvin regime requires refrigerant materials to retain a large magnetic entropy at low temperatures by suppressing magnetic ordering. Quantum spin liquids (QSLs), which evade long-range magnetic ordering while retaining strong quantum fluctuations to the lowest temperatures, therefore provide a promising platform for realizing high-performance magnetic refrigerants. Here, we investigate the magnetic ground state and the magnetocaloric effect of the hexaaluminate, NdMgAl$_{11}$O$_{19}$, in which the Nd$^{3+}$ ions form a network of triangular lattices. Magnetic susceptibility and specific heat measurements indicate a magnetically dynamic state down to 50~mK, consistent with a QSL state. Specific heat measurements further reveal substantial magnetic entropy retained below 50~mK. Quasi-adiabatic demagnetization measurements demonstrate a superior cooling performance of NdMgAl$_{11}$O$_{19}$, which can be cooled to 113~mK from 1.9~K by only a small magnetic field change of 2~T. The outstanding refrigeration performance is attributed to the persistent spin fluctuations associated with the QSL-like ground state, together with a large effective \textit{g} factor and the smallness of the exchange interactions along the easy-axis direction. This study demonstrates that frustration, combined with strong spin-orbit coupling and crystal-electric-field effect in the rare earth magnets provides a promising design principle for next-generation cryogenic magnetic refrigerants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究六铝酸盐NdMgAl₁₁O₁₉的磁基态与磁致冷效应，发现其表现出量子自旋液体（QSL）态，在50 mK以下仍保持大量磁熵；准绝热退磁实验显示仅需2 T的磁场变化即可从1.9 K降温至113 mK，展现出优异的低温磁制冷性能。
AI.motivation: 亚开尔文温区磁制冷需要抑制磁有序、保留大磁熵的制冷剂材料，而量子自旋液体（QSL）因回避长程磁有序且在极低温保持强量子涨落，成为实现高性能磁制冷剂的理想平台。作者因此探索NdMgAl₁₁O₁₉的QSL态及其磁致冷效应。
AI.method: 采用磁化率与比热测量分析磁基态；通过准绝热退磁实验评估制冷性能。
AI.result: NdMgAl₁₁O₁₉在50 mK以下保持磁动力学活性（QSL态），比热显示大量磁熵保留；仅2 T磁场变化即可从1.9 K冷却至113 mK，制冷性能优异。
AI.conclusion: QSL基态的持续自旋涨落、大有效g因子以及易轴方向的小交换相互作用共同赋予了优异的制冷表现。该研究表明，稀土磁体中几何阻挫、强自旋-轨道耦合与晶场效应的结合，为下一代低温磁制冷剂提供了有前景的设计原则。

title: Magnetic Contributions to Phase Stability in the Co-Ni Binary: A First-Principles CALPHAD Study
summary: We propose a simple method to employ ab-initio calculations to determine magnetic contributions to free energy of alloys. Validation on the Co-Ni binary demonstrates that this ab initio approach reproduces experimental FCC-HCP phase equilibria while providing physically transparent, structure-dependent magnetic parameters suitable for multicomponent extrapolation. Our results demonstrate that physically grounded magnetic parametrization, derived directly from electronic structure calculations, enables predictive phase diagram modeling for magnetic alloy systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于第一性原理计算合金磁自由能贡献的简单方法。在Co-Ni二元系上的验证表明，该方法能复现实验FCC-HCP相平衡，并提供物理透明、结构依赖的磁参数，适用于多组分外推。结果证明，从电子结构计算直接导出的物理基磁参数化方法可实现磁性合金体系的预测性相图建模。
AI.motivation: 现有合金相图建模缺乏从电子结构层面直接导出磁性自由能贡献的方法，导致磁性参数缺乏物理透明性和结构依赖性，难以准确外推至多组分体系。
AI.method: 提出一种简单的第一性原理方法，直接从电子结构计算中导出磁性对合金自由能的贡献，获得物理透明且结构依赖的磁参数。
AI.result: 在Co-Ni二元系中，该方法成功复现了实验观测到的FCC-HCP相平衡。
AI.conclusion: 基于电子结构计算的物理基磁参数化方法能够实现磁性合金体系的预测性相图建模。

title: Coherent Bose-Einstein condensation with fluctuating density
summary: Bose-Einstein condensation in the grand canonical ensemble admits a formulation in terms of a phase-density decomposition of the condensate mode operator $\hatψ_{\bf 0}$. In the presence of macroscopic condensate number fluctuations this representation presents nontrivial implications. In particular, we show that, for the ideal gas, under the assumption of a well-defined phase and a fluctuating condensate density, the full hierarchy of correlation functions is determined by the statistics of the density. Within this framework, the modulus squared of the anomalous average $\langle \hatψ_{\bf 0}\rangle$ can provide only a fraction of the whole condensate density $ρ_{\bf 0}$ and for the grand canonical statistics of the ideal Bose gas one obtains the value $|\langle {\hat ψ}_{\bf 0}\rangle|^2 =(π/4) ρ_{\bf 0}$. The remaining part is supplemented by the (macroscopic) fluctuations of $\hatψ_{\bf 0}$, which become a distinctive feature of the BEC in this setting. This provides a transparent physical picture of a condensate of photons with a well-defined phase but large number fluctuations, as observed in dye-filled microcavity photon experiments. We also propose a way to access the square modulus of the anomalous average to test theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）在巨正则系综中通过相位-密度分解描述凝聚模算符，发现理想玻色气体在相位确定但密度涨落较大时，关联函数完全由密度统计决定，异常平均的模平方仅贡献部分凝聚密度（π/4 ρ₀），宏观涨落成为BEC的显著特征，为光子BEC实验提供了物理解释，并提出了检验理论预测的方法。
AI.motivation: 在巨正则系综中，BEC存在宏观粒子数涨落，传统的相位-密度分解面临非平凡问题。本文旨在阐明该框架下凝聚体的统计行为，尤其是异常平均与密度涨落的关系，并为光子BEC实验结果提供理论支持。
AI.method: 采用巨正则系综下的相位-密度分解方法，对理想玻色气体的凝聚模算符进行分析。假设相位定义良好、凝聚密度涨落，推导关联函数层次结构，并计算异常平均的模平方与凝聚密度的比值。
AI.result: 对于理想玻色气体的巨正则统计，异常平均的模平方仅为凝聚密度的π/4倍，即|⟨ŝψ₀⟩|² = (π/4)ρ₀；剩余部分由凝聚模算符的宏观涨落补充，这成为该设定下BEC的标志性特征。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为具有明确相位但粒子数大幅涨落的光子BEC（如染料填充微腔实验）提供了清晰的物理图像，并提出了测量异常平均模平方以检验理论预测的实验方案。

title: Emergent $s+id$ Superconductivity from the Interplay between Electronic Correlations and Electron-Phonon Coupling in $\mathrm{R}_{1-x}\mathrm{Sr}_x\mathrm{NiO}_2$
summary: Recent tunneling measurements on infinite-layer nickelates have revealed spatially varying superconducting symmetries, whose microscopic origin remains unclear. Motivated by this observation, we investigate the interplay between electron correlations and electron-phonon interactions in infinite-layer nickelates by combining first-principles calculations with the fluctuation-exchange-Migdal-Eliashberg theory. Our calculations show that spin fluctuations yield robust $d$-wave superconductivity on the Ni $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital, whereas electron-phonon coupling induces $s$-wave pairing on an interstitial orbital, leading to an $s+id$ superconducting state. The emergence of the $s$-wave component is strongly carrier-density dependent: an intermediate electron-phonon coupling of $λ=0.4$ stabilizes the $s+id$ state at $n=0.9$ but not at $n=0.8$. These results imply that local oxygen defects tune the local electron density and form finite-size domains with distinct pairing symmetries, offering a compelling explanation for the spatially inhomogeneous superconducting symmetries observed in experiments.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理计算和涨落交换-Migdal-Eliashberg理论，发现无限层镍氧化物中自旋涨落驱动Ni d轨道的d波超导，而电声耦合驱动间隙轨道的s波超导，两者共存形成s+id态，且s波成分强烈依赖载流子密度，解释了实验中观测到的空间不均匀超导对称性。
AI.motivation: 实验观察到无限层镍氧化物中超导对称性存在空间变化，但其微观起源尚不清楚，本文旨在揭示这一现象的物理机制。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理计算与涨落交换-Migdal-Eliashberg理论（FLEX-ME），同时考虑电子关联和电声耦合的相互作用。
AI.result: 自旋涨落在Ni d_{x^2-y^2}轨道上产生稳健的d波超导；电声耦合在间隙轨道上诱导s波配对，形成s+id超导态。s波成分的稳定依赖于载流子密度：λ=0.4时，n=0.9下s+id态稳定，n=0.8下则不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 局域氧缺陷会调节局域电子密度，形成具有不同配对对称性的有限尺寸畴区，为实验中观察到的空间不均匀超导对称性提供了合理解释。

title: Effect of the local field and dipole-dipole interaction on the spontaneous ordering of dipole moments in bismuth monolayers with an orthorhombic structure
summary: Using two complementary approaches, the instability of bismuth monolayers with an orthorhombic structure with respect to the emergence of spontaneous electric dipole moments at the crystal lattice sites has been studied. The first approach, based on determining the dipole moments of lattice sites through the polarizability of bismuth atoms and taking into account the local Lorentz-Lorenz field, suggests the possibility of the existence of several antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases in orthorhombic bismuth monolayers. Using the second approach, the vibrational spectrum of a nonpolar symmetric lattice has been analyzed, and two types of soft optical modes corresponding to the ferroelectric and antiferroelectric instabilities of the monolayers have been revealed. The relationship of the Born effective charges to the polarization direction in the ferroelectric phase, as well as their role in the reduction of the frequency of the polar optical phonon, which characterizes the lattice deformation in the ferroelectric phase due to the dipole-dipole interaction, has been shown.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两种方法揭示了正交结构铋单层中自发电极矩的不稳定性，发现了多种反铁电和铁电相，并识别出对应铁电和反铁电不稳定性的软光学模式。
AI.motivation: 探究正交结构铋单层中自发电极矩（电偶极矩）产生的不稳定性，理解其铁电和反铁电相变的物理机制。
AI.method: 方法一：基于原子极化率和局域洛伦兹-洛伦茨场确定晶格位点的偶极矩；方法二：分析非极性对称晶格的振动谱，识别软光学模式。
AI.result: 发现可能存在多种反铁电和铁电相；揭示了两类软光学模式（对应铁电和反铁电不稳定性）；展示了Born有效电荷与极化方向的关系及其对极化声子频率的调制作用。
AI.conclusion: 正交结构铋单层存在固有的铁电和反铁电不稳定性，偶极-偶极相互作用和Born有效电荷对极化声子频率和铁电相变起关键作用。

title: Zero-Field Long Range Order at $T \sim 40$ mK in the Proximate Quantum Spin Ice Ce$_2$Sn$_2$O$_7$ and Phase Diagram for Magnetic Fields Along [1,1,0]
comment: Main Text (5 pages, 4 figures), Supplemental Material (6 pages, 4 figures)
summary: The Ce$^{3+}$ pseudospin-1/2 degrees of freedom in the pyrochlore magnets Ce$_2$X$_2$O$_7$, with $X$ = Zr, Hf, or Sn, possess dipole-octupole character. The XYZ nearest-neighbor model Hamiltonians which have successfully described their properties make them attractive candidates for quantum spin ice ground states. We report new heat capacity measurements to very low temperatures on a high-quality single crystal of Ce$_2$Sn$_2$O$_7$ grown by hydrothermal techniques. Our zero-field measurements uncover a clear first order transition to long-ranged order at $T \sim 0.04$ K, well below the downturn in the broader Schottky-like anomaly that is a common feature in the zero-field heat capacity for cerium pyrochlores. This observation settles the debate as to whether Ce$_2$Sn$_2$O$_7$ possesses a QSI ground state in zero field - it does not. However, we also find compelling evidence suggesting that spin ice physics is nearby, and remains relevant to Ce$_2$Sn$_2$O$_7$. Application of a magnetic field along the $[1,1,0]$ direction leads to an evolution of this peak to a weak anomaly at higher temperature more characteristic of a continuous, mean field transition. At higher fields along $[1,1,0]$, the Schottky-like anomaly bifurcates similar to expectations for independent polarized $α$ and orthogonal $β$ chains in classical spin ice. These new experimental results demonstrate richness to the phase diagram for Ce-based pyrochlores.

AI.tldr: 通过对高质量Ce₂Sn₂O₇单晶的极低温热容测量，发现在零场下约0.04 K处存在一级相变（长程有序），否定了其处于量子自旋冰基态的可能性；但外加[1,1,0]方向磁场后，系统展现出与经典自旋冰相似的物理行为，表明自旋冰物理仍与之相关。
AI.motivation: Ce₂X₂O₇（X=Zr, Hf, Sn）烧绿石磁体中的Ce³⁺具有偶极-八极子特性，其XYZ最近邻模型哈密顿量被认为是量子自旋冰（QSI）基态的有力候选。然而Ce₂Sn₂O₇是否在零场下具有QSI基态存在争论，本文通过极低温热容测量解决这一争议。
AI.method: 采用水热法生长高质量Ce₂Sn₂O₇单晶，在极低温（~0.04 K）下进行零场和[1,1,0]方向磁场下的热容测量。
AI.result: (1) 零场下在~0.04 K处观察到清晰的一级相变（长程有序），否定了零场QSI基态；(2) 沿[1,1,0]施加磁场后，该相变峰演变为更高温的连续平均场相变特征；(3) 更高磁场下，肖特基型异常发生分叉，类似于经典自旋冰中独立极化α链和正交β链的行为。
AI.conclusion: Ce₂Sn₂O₇在零场下不存在量子自旋冰基态，但自旋冰物理在有限磁场下仍然相关，揭示了Ce基烧绿石中丰富的相图。

title: Quantized Photocurrents in Gapless Topological Matter
summary: The quantum Hall effect in gapped systems represents a defining signature of nontrivial topology. Realizing this principle in gapless matter has remained a central challenge in quantum materials. Chiral topological semimetals provide a unique platform to achieve this aim via symmetry-protected multifold crossings that act as Berry-curvature monopoles. When optical transitions are confined to a single multifold node, the resulting circular photogalvanic effect is predicted to be quantized in terms of the topological charge of the node. In real materials, however, this phenomenon remains experimentally elusive, obscured by trivial band transitions, the energy separation between the node pairs, and their relative positions with respect to the Fermi level. Here we observe a quantized circular photogalvanic effect in the chiral topological semimetal Rh0.95Ni0.05Si. Ni substitution opens a photon-energy window dominated by interband optical transitions at the Γ-point multifold node. This allows circularly polarized near- to mid-infrared pulses to drive a helicity-odd terahertz response that manifests three hallmarks of quantization: a sharp onset, a wavelength-independent plateau governed by the magnitude of monopole charge, and an abrupt cutoff imposed by Pauli blocking. Our work establishes an all-optical analogue for the quantum Hall effect and a new paradigm for topological quantization in gapless matter.

AI.tldr: 本文在Rh0.95Ni0.05Si手性拓扑半金属中实验观测到了量子化的圆光生伏打效应，该效应由多重点处的贝里曲率单极子主导，表现为量子霍尔效应的全光学类比物。
AI.motivation: 在有能隙系统中，量子霍尔效应是非平庸拓扑的标志性特征。在无能隙物质中实现这一定律是量子材料领域的核心挑战。手性拓扑半金属因其受对称性保护的多重交叉（充当贝里曲率单极子）而提供了实现该目标的独特平台。
AI.method: 通过Ni替代掺杂（Rh0.95Ni0.05Si）打开一个光子能量窗口，使得Γ点多重结点处的带间光学跃迁占主导。采用近-中红外圆偏振脉冲激发，测量其引发的螺旋度奇异的太赫兹响应。
AI.result: 观测到量子化圆光生伏打效应的三个标志性特征：陡峭的起始、由单极子电荷大小决定且与波长无关的平台、以及Pauli阻塞导致的突然截止。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作建立了量子霍尔效应的全光学类比物，并为无能隙物质中的拓扑量子化提供了新范式。

title: Optimal preparation and reachable-state constraints in the Mpemba effect
summary: The Mpemba effect, whereby an initially hotter system relaxes faster than a colder one towards a common final state, is often analysed within the kinetic framework by assuming non-stationary initial conditions that are selected a priori. Here, we revisit this viewpoint by explicitly incorporating the aging protocol used to prepare those states. Focusing on uniformly heated granular fluids, we formulate the preparation stage as an optimal-control problem in which the energy injection is tuned to generate the initial conditions that maximise or minimise the subsequent relaxation rate. Within the first Sonine approximation, this optimisation reduces to extremising the excess kurtosis of the velocity distribution function, the quantity controlling the cooling rate at fixed temperature. Applying Pontryagin's maximum principle, we show that the optimal preparation protocol is always a one-bang protocol and determine the corresponding extremal values of the excess kurtosis. Most importantly, we find that the stochastic thermostat imposes non-trivial reachable-state constraints: the accessible non-Gaussianities are bounded by those of the homogeneous cooling state, thereby limiting the relaxation-rate asymmetry and the maximum attainable Mpemba effect. These results demonstrate that the strength of the kinetic Mpemba effect cannot be disentangled from the accessibility of the underlying non-equilibrium states. More generally, our work establishes a connection between anomalous relaxation, optimal control, and state accessibility in non-equilibrium systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过最优控制理论重新审视Mpemba效应（热者愈冷），发现在均匀加热颗粒流体中，制备协议对非平衡态的可行性施加了根本性约束，导致动力学Mpemba效应的强度无法脱离状态可达性来讨论。
AI.motivation: 以往研究Mpemba效应时，非平稳初始条件往往是先验选定的，忽视了实际制备这些状态所用的老化（aging）协议。作者希望从最优控制的角度，系统研究制备过程如何影响乃至约束后续的冷却速率和Mpemba效应的大小。
AI.method: 采用最优控制框架，将制备阶段建模为能量注入的调控问题，以最大化或最小化后续冷却速率；在第一次Sonine近似下，将优化简化为对速度分布函数超额峰度（excess kurtosis）的极值问题；利用Pontryagin最大值原理求解最优协议。
AI.result: 最优制备协议始终为"单脉冲"（one-bang）协议；可达到的非高斯性被均匀冷却状态（HCS）所界定的范围限制，从而约束了弛豫速率的不对称性和最大可实现的Mpemba效应。
AI.conclusion: 动力学Mpemba效应的强弱与底层非平衡态的可达性密不可分；本研究建立了反常弛豫、最优控制和状态可达性之间的新联系。

title: Geometric Spin-Orbit Coupling Resolves the Contradictory CISS Effect in Chiral Single Molecules
summary: Some studies have reported clear chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect in four classes of chiral single molecules with remarkable spin polarization. In contrast, a recent high-precision measurement involving nearly a thousand individual tests failed to detect significant CISS signals in the same molecular systems (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2025, \textbf{147}, 25043). These conflicting results cast doubt on whether CISS truly occurs in these chiral systems at the single-molecular level. To resolve this discrepancy, we develop a theoretical framework incorporating geometric spin-orbit coupling and environmental decoherence, enabling systematic study of the CISS in four chiral single molecules with distinct geometries and sizes. Our calculations show that the CISS effect is completely suppressed in both strong-coherence and strong-decoherence regimes, but becomes pronounced in the intermediate-decoherence regime, where observable spin polarization emerges. In the strong-coherence regime, both electron-electron interaction and electron-vibration coupling enhance the CISS effect: the former is more effective in large molecules, whereas the latter plays a more significant role in smaller ones. Increasing temperature further enhances spin polarization. The proposed mechanism unifies contradictory experimental observations and reveals how the CISS effect evolves from regular helical (helical symmetric) to irregular helical (point-symmetric or axially symmetric) chirality. This framework thus provides a basis for unifying CISS phenomena across single-molecule systems, regardless of their specific molecular configurations or symmetry classes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出包含几何自旋轨道耦合和环境退相干的统一理论框架，证明手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应仅在中等退相干区间显著，在强相干和强退相干区间被完全抑制，从而调和了单分子层面CISS效应的矛盾实验结果。
AI.motivation: 已有研究报告了四类手性单分子中存在显著的自旋极化CISS效应，但近期高精度测量（近千次独立测试）却未检测到明显CISS信号。这些矛盾结果对单分子层面CISS的真实存在性提出了质疑，亟需一个统一的理论框架来化解争议。
AI.method: 建立融合几何自旋轨道耦合和环境退相干的理论框架，系统研究四种不同几何构型和尺寸的手性单分子中的CISS效应，分析电子-电子相互作用、电子-振动耦合以及温度等因素的影响。
AI.result: CISS效应在强相干和强退相干区间完全被抑制，仅在中等退相干区间显著出现自旋极化。在强相干区间，电子-电子相互作用对大分子更有效，电子-振动耦合对小分子更重要；温度升高会进一步增强自旋极化。
AI.conclusion: 该机制统一了矛盾实验观测，揭示了CISS效应如何从规则螺旋手性演化到不规则螺旋手性，为不同分子构型或对称性类别的单分子系统提供了统一的CISS现象基础。

title: Measurement-induced phase transition in space
summary: Measurement-induced phase transitions (MIPTs) in monitored quantum circuits are usually characterized by preparing steady states at different uniform measurement probabilities. Here we introduce a spatial realization of the MIPT by imposing a deterministic measurement gradient in a single monitored Clifford chain. The resulting steady state contains coexisting volume-law, critical, and area-law regions, with the point $p(x)=p_c$ acting as a spatial critical cut. By scanning entanglement observables across this profile, we show that the transition is organized by a spatial scaling form. Although this structure is analogous to finite-time scaling in temporally driven MIPT, the spatial protocol has no Kibble-Zurek dynamics. Instead, the physical bounds $0\le p\le 1$ impose a finite linear window, producing cutoff-controlled asymptotic regimes whose fitted exponents provide direct access to the correlation-length exponent $ν$. Our results establish spatially inhomogeneous measurements as a controlled route to engineer and probe measurement-induced criticality within a single steady state.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在单一Clifford链上施加空间非均匀的测量梯度，在单个稳态中同时实现体积律、临界和面积律区域的共存，并利用空间标度形式提取关联长度指数ν。
AI.motivation: 传统MIPT研究依赖于均匀测量概率下的稳态制备，缺乏在单个稳态中同时观察不同相区域的手段，且有限时间标度存在Kibble-Zurek动力学干扰。
AI.method: 在受监测的Clifford量子链上施加确定性测量梯度p(x)，使空间不同位置对应不同的测量概率，从而在同一稳态中形成体积律、临界与面积律共存的区域布局。
AI.result: 通过扫描纠缠可观测量，展示了空间标度形式组织相变；物理边界0≤p≤1提供了有限线性窗口，通过截断控制的渐近区域直接拟合得到关联长度指数ν。
AI.conclusion: 空间非均匀测量为在单个稳态中工程化并探测测量诱导临界性提供了可控途径，避免了Kibble-Zurek动力学的干扰。

title: Many-body interactions in the dielectric theory of stopping power of solids for classical and quantum projectiles
summary: We take account of the many-body dynamic interactions by including the wave-vector and frequency-dependent exchange and correlations (xc) kernel $f_{xc}(\qv,ω)$ in the framework of the dielectric theory of the stopping power of crystals for moving charges. The cases of classical and quantum projectiles are considered. We find that (I) the role of the xc effects in slowing of charges in crystalline solids is more pronounced than it is within the jellium model and (II) For velocities below the stopping maximum, inclusion of xc leads to the improvement of the comparison of the theory with experiment over a range of solid targets. On the other hand, in the high-velocity regime, the role of the dynamic xc proves negligible, which does not contradict experiment, and which we substantiate analytically within the jellium model of the target. The input to our theory is the microscopic dielectric matrix $ε_{\Gv \Gv'}(\qv,ω)$ within the random phase approximation (i.e., with neglect of $f_{xc}$), the calculation of which matrix is implemented in the existing solid-state codes.

AI.tldr: 本文在晶体能损理论中引入波矢和频率依赖的交换关联核（xc kernel），发现xc效应在晶体中比在凝胶模型中更显著，低能区改善理论与实验吻合，高能区xc效应可忽略。
AI.motivation: 现有能损理论多基于凝胶模型，忽略了晶体中多体动态交换关联效应。作者希望更准确地描述带电粒子在晶体中的能量损失过程，特别是在中低速度区域。
AI.method: 在介电理论框架中引入波矢和频率依赖的交换关联核 $f_{xc}(\qv,ω)$，考虑经典和量子两种抛射体，利用随机相位近似（RPA）下的微观介电矩阵作为输入。
AI.result: (I) 晶体中xc效应比凝胶模型更显著；(II) 在低于能损最大值的速度区域，xc的引入改善了与实验的吻合；在高速度区域，动态xc效应可忽略，与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 多体交换关联效应对晶体能损有重要贡献，尤其在低速区不可忽略；高能区则可安全忽略。该方法可基于现有固体能带计算代码实现。

title: Dynamical Generation of Rectified Electric Current
summary: Rectification is a fundamental nonlinear transport process that converts an alternating drive into a direct current. In this work, we propose a general theoretical framework for electric current rectification triggered by a dynamical external drive that couples to an arbitrary well-defined operator of a periodic system, and which in the static limit forbids any steady current. In the dynamical regime, the finite frequency $Ω$ of the time-varying drive breaks time-translation invariance and injects energy into the system, enabling a second-order {\it nonlinear rectified} current that has no static counterpart. This rectification process has two distinct origins: (i) an impurity-scattering-modified distribution function at finite frequency, and (ii) a time-domain anomalous velocity stemming from a dynamical mixed Berry curvature. Both contributions persist when the driving frequency lies well below the optical transition gap. Applying our general theory to a buckled magnetic system subject to an out-of-plane oscillating electric field, we characterize the generated current as a {\it nonlinear magnetoelectric gyrotropic effect} and predict that the induced rectified current is sensitive to the magnetic order, thereby offering a feasible electrical probe of Néel order in non-coplanar antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个通用理论框架，研究周期性系统中由动态外部驱动引发的电流整流现象，该整流电流源于有限频率下的杂质散射修正分布函数和动态混合Berry曲率引起的时间域反常速度，并应用于磁场体系，预测了一种非共面反铁磁体中敏感于磁序的非线性磁电陀螺效应。
AI.motivation: 传统整流效应依赖静态非对称性（如p-n结），而动态驱动下周期性系统中的整流机制尚未被系统阐述。本文旨在建立一般性理论，揭示有限频率驱动如何打破时间平移对称性，产生静态下不存在的非线性整流电流。
AI.method: 构建了一个通用理论框架，将动态外部驱动耦合到周期性系统的任意明确定义算符上。通过分析有限频率Ω下的非线性响应，区分了两种整流起源：(i) 有限频率下杂质散射修正的分布函数；(ii) 动态混合Berry曲率导致的时间域反常速度。理论适用于驱动频率远低于光学跃迁带隙的情况。
AI.result: 将理论应用于面外振荡电场驱动的翘曲磁性系统，发现产生的电流表现为非线性磁电陀螺效应，且该整流电流对磁序敏感，可作为非共面反铁磁体中Néel序的电学探测手段。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了动态驱动下周期性系统电流整流的一般理论，揭示了两种独立贡献机制，并预言了在反铁磁材料中实现磁序电学探测的新途径，为非平衡输运和自旋电子学提供了理论工具。

title: Compatibility of Martensitic Microstructures in Polycrystals
summary:
The paper studies martensitic microstructures in polycrystals, focussing on their compatibility across grain boundaries. After a reduction to the case of a planar grain boundary, the case when the grain boundary separates two constant gradients of zero energy is considered. It is shown that for cubic-to tetragonal transformations such a configuration can occur when the relative grain rotation is not in the cubic group. Then the case when the grain boundary separates two simple laminates of zero energy is considered, it being shown using a computer-assisted symbolic calculation that in the cubic-to-tetragonal case compatibility is only possible for a closed set of measure zero in the manifold of grain boundary normals and relative grain rotations, and that a similar slightly weaker result holds for cubic-to-orthorhombic transformations. The results suggest why higher-order laminates are often observed for such transformations.
  The Taylor set of deformation gradients is defined and studied, this set having the property that any deformation whose gradient belongs to it corresponds to a zero-energy microstructure for the polycrystal independent of grain geometry and grain rotations. New upper bounds for the Taylor set are proved for cubic-to-tetragonal and cubic-to-orthorhombic transformations, generalizing those of Bhattacharya and Kohn using the geometrically linearized theory. The bounds imply in particular a result of Peigney characterizing the positive diagonal matrices in the quasiconvex hull of three tetragonal wells, and we give a simple independent proof of this result.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多晶中马氏体微结构在晶界处的相容性。通过简化到平面晶界情况，分析了立方到四方和立方到正交相变中，零能梯度与简单层状微结构在晶界处的相容条件。结果表明，高阶层状微结构常被观察到的原因在于简单层状结构仅在零测度集中可行。此外，定义了Taylor变形梯度集并给出新上界，推广了Bhattacharya和Kohn的线性几何理论结果。
AI.motivation: 理解多晶中马氏体微结构在晶界处的相容性，解释为何高阶层状微结构常被观察到。
AI.method: 将问题简化为平面晶界情形，分别考虑晶界两侧为常零能梯度和简单层状零能微结构的情况。使用计算机辅助符号计算分析相容性条件。定义Taylor集并证明其上界。
AI.result: 立方到四方相变中，晶界两侧为常零能梯度时，非立方群相对旋转可产生相容配置。简单层状结构仅在晶界法向和相对旋转的零测度集中相容。立方到正交相变有类似但稍弱的结果。获得了Taylor集的新上界，推广了已有线性理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 简单层状微结构在多晶中几乎不可能在晶界处相容，这解释了为何高阶层状微结构常被观察到。Taylor集的新上界为理解多晶零能微结构提供了更精确的刻画。

title: What Is the Real-Time Atomistic Mechanism Behind Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity in Donor-Chiral Bridge-Acceptor Molecules?
summary: Chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) has been experimentally observed in photo-excited donor-chiral bridge-acceptor (D-Bχ-A) molecules [Science 382, 197-201 (2023)]. However, the microscopic mechanism underlying CISS in such chiral systems remains elusive. Here we develop a quantum dynamical model that precisely maps the atomic structure of binaphthyl-type bridge dimers in isolated D-Bχ-A molecules and introduce a geometric spin-orbit coupling (SOC) mechanism to unveil the intrinsic origin of CISS in axially chiral systems. During photo-excited electron transport along the twisted pathways, the geometric SOC coupling strength exceeds the intrinsic coupling of light atoms by one to two orders of magnitude, readily producing observable high spin polarizations. The resulting spin polarization comprises two components: the CISS-associated polarizations along and perpendicular to the chiral axis are intrinsic to axial chirality, requiring neither external fields nor spin-superexchange transfer, while a non-Abelian curvature correction provides a rigorous mathematical definition of the chiral axis direction.
