Our calculated polarization components, chirality dependence, and relative magnitudes (30-40\%) quantitatively match time-resolved electron paramagnetic resonance measurements. This geometric SOC framework offers a self-consistent and general physical picture of CISS in axially chiral molecules and provides explicit theoretical guidance for the design of chiral spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文针对手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）在光激发供体-手性桥-受体（D-Bχ-A）分子中的微观机制，提出了一种基于几何自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）的量子动力学模型，成功解释了轴向手性体系中高达30-40%的自旋极化，定量吻合实验观测。
AI.motivation: 实验上已在D-Bχ-A分子中观测到CISS效应，但其微观机制尚不明确，亟需从理论上揭示其内在物理起源。
AI.method: 发展了一种精确映射联萘型桥二聚体原子结构的量子动力学模型，引入几何自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）机制，结合非阿贝尔曲率修正来严格定义手性轴方向。
AI.result: 几何SOC耦合强度比轻原子固有SOC强1-2个数量级，产生沿手性轴和垂直于手性轴两个方向的自旋极化分量（各30-40%），定量匹配时间分辨电子顺磁共振测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 几何SOC框架为轴向手性分子的CISS效应提供了自洽且普适的物理图像，并为手性自旋电子器件的设计提供了明确理论指导。

title: Research on topological materials using ultrafast spectroscopy
comment: 40 pages, 10 figures. This manuscript is an English translation version of our original paper published in Acta Physica Sinica
summary: Topological materials, characterized by symmetry-protected nontrivial band structures such as Dirac cones and Weyl nodes, host diverse quantum phenomena, with potential applications in quantum transport, spintronics, and nonlinear optics. Ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy has emerged as a powerful tool for exploring nonequilibrium dynamics in these systems. Its femtosecond resolution allows charge, spin, orbital, and lattice interactions to be tracked on their intrinsic timescales, thereby revealing key coupling mechanisms in topological phases. This review summarizes progress in ultrafast spectroscopic studies of topological insulators, topological semimetals, and magnetic topological materials. We first discuss the relaxation pathways of photoexcited surface and bulk electronic states, emphasizing electron-phonon scattering, surface-bulk charge transfer, and ultrafast spin conversion. We then examine population inversion in Dirac and Weyl semimetals, spin-polarization dynamics associated with tilted Weyl bands, and the effects of magnetic order on topological states, including coherent phonon and magnon excitations, magnetically driven topological transitions, and terahertz emission. We further review photoinduced topological phase transitions driven by electronic correlations, lattice distortions, and magnetic order under intense optical excitation, highlighting routes toward nonthermal control of quantum phases. Finally, we outline future directions that combine multidimensional ultrafast spectroscopy with temporal, energy, momentum, and spin resolution and advanced theoretical modeling to establish a unified picture of nonequilibrium topological states. This review aims to provide a useful reference for ultrafast studies of topological quantum materials and to advance their applications in high-speed, low-power information processing, spintronics, and quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了超快泵浦-探测光谱技术在拓扑材料（包括拓扑绝缘体、拓扑半金属和磁性拓扑材料）非平衡态动力学研究中的进展，涵盖了光激发载流子弛豫、自旋动力学、光致拓扑相变等关键机制，并展望了多维度超快光谱与理论建模结合的未来方向。
AI.motivation: 拓扑材料具有丰富的量子现象和潜在应用价值，但对其非平衡态动力学和耦合机制的理解尚不充分，亟需系统梳理超快光谱学在该领域的研究进展。
AI.method: 采用超快泵浦-探测光谱技术，利用飞秒时间分辨率追踪电荷、自旋、轨道和晶格相互作用的本征时间尺度，研究拓扑材料的非平衡态过程。
AI.result: 总结了表面/体态电子弛豫路径（电子-声子散射、表面-体电荷转移、超快自旋转换）、狄拉克/外尔半金属中的粒子数反转与自旋极化动力学、磁有序对拓扑态的影响（相干声子/磁子激发、磁驱动拓扑转变、太赫兹发射），以及电子关联、晶格畸变和磁序驱动的光致拓扑相变。
AI.conclusion: 多维度超快光谱（时间、能量、动量、自旋分辨）与理论建模的结合将建立统一的非平衡拓扑态图景，推动拓扑材料在高速低功耗信息处理、自旋电子学和量子技术中的应用。

title: Emergent exchange bias in ultra-thin La0.67Sr0.33MnO3 films driven by ferro-antiferromagnetic phase coexistence
summary: Ultra-thin La0.67Sr0.33MnO3 (LSMO) films are generally regarded as single-phase ferromagnets, yet their reduced dimensionality enhances the impact of oxygen stoichiometry and local structural distortions. Here we demonstrate that LSMO layers with thicknesses between 3 and 17 nm develop a robust and thickness-independent exchange bias (EB) despite the absence of an engineered ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic (FM-AFM) interface. Angular magneto-optical Kerr effect measurements reveal a reproducible hysteresis-loop shift that reverses sign upon 180-degree rotation, confirming its intrinsic origin. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy shows a thickness-independent Mn2+ fraction (about 20 percent), indicating the presence of oxygen-deficient reduced regions embedded within the Mn3+/Mn4+ ferromagnetic matrix. A simple interfacial-exchange model suggests that only a sub-percent fraction of antiferromagnetic (or frustrated spin-ice-like) regions is required to generate the observed EB. These results demonstrate that ultra-thin LSMO can spontaneously host internal FM-AFM interfaces driven by oxygen deficiency, revealing an emergent route to exchange bias in nominally single-phase manganite films.

AI.tldr: 超薄La0.67Sr0.33MnO3 (LSMO)薄膜（3-17 nm）虽无刻意构筑的铁磁-反铁磁界面，却展现出稳定且厚度无关的交换偏置效应。这一现象源于氧空位导致的Mn2+区域（约20%）嵌入铁磁基质中，形成自发内部铁磁-反铁磁界面。
AI.motivation: 探究超薄LSMO薄膜中是否存在非刻意引入的交换偏置效应，揭示低维化下氧化学计量与局域结构畸变对磁性的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用角分辨磁光Kerr效应测量确认交换偏置的固有属性；X射线光电子能谱分析Mn价态分布；构建界面交换模型进行理论解释。
AI.result: 发现3-17 nm LSMO薄膜具有厚度无关的交换偏置效应；Mn2+比例约20%且与厚度无关；仅需亚百分比的反铁磁（或自旋冰状）区域即可解释观测到的交换偏置。
AI.conclusion: 超薄LSMO可自发形成由氧空位驱动的内部铁磁-反铁磁界面，为名义单相锰氧化物薄膜中的交换偏置提供了一条新兴途径。

title: Microscopic Spin-1 Parent Hamiltonians for Emergent Valence-Bond Loop Manifolds
summary: We construct an exact spin-$1$ parent Hamiltonian for constrained valence-bond loop manifolds on the checkerboard and pyrochlore lattices. The Hamiltonian is local, SU(2)- and time-reversal-invariant, and built from positive-semidefinite projectors acting on triangular faces. Each projector removes only the maximally polarized state of a triangle, so the model is frustration-free. Its zero-energy states are generated by an AKLT-like construction in which each spin-$1$ moment is resolved into two virtual spin-$\tfrac12$ degrees of freedom, singlets are formed inside every crossed plaquette or tetrahedron, and the physical spin-$1$ Hilbert space is recovered by projection. The resulting ground states are fully packed singlet-loop states on the corner-sharing lattice. Thus, a loop or dimer constraint, usually introduced as part of an effective Rokhsar--Kivelson description, appears here as the exact zero-energy manifold of a microscopic spin Hamiltonian. We analyze spin correlations within this manifold and show that, for a fixed loop covering, they are determined by loop connectivity. We also project symmetry-allowed perturbations into the ground-state manifold and derive the resulting low-energy pseudospin dynamics. The checkerboard and pyrochlore cases differ sharply. On the pyrochlore lattice, tetrahedral symmetry removes simple local bias terms, and the leading nontrivial next-nearest-neighbour Heisenberg perturbation gives an emergent spin-$\tfrac12$ XY model on the diamond lattice of tetrahedron centers. These results give an exact spin-$1$ microscopic starting point for constrained valence-bond physics in two and three dimensions, and show how loop, dimer, and gauge-theoretic descriptions can be approached from a small-spin, SU(2)-invariant frustrated magnet.

AI.tldr: 本文在棋盘格和烧绿石晶格上构造了精确的自旋-1母哈密顿量，其零能态对应于完全填满的价键单态环构型。该哈密顿量是局域、SU(2)和时间反演不变的，由三角形面上的正半定投影子构建。在烧绿石上，次近邻海森堡微扰导致金刚石晶格上的有效自旋-1/2 XY模型。
AI.motivation: 从微观自旋哈密顿量出发，严格实现通常只在Rokhsar-Kivelson有效理论中出现的环/二聚体约束，为约束价键物理提供精确的微观起点。
AI.method: 利用AKLT型构造：将每个自旋-1分解为两个虚拟自旋-1/2，在交叉方格或四面体内形成单态，再通过投影恢复物理自旋-1希尔伯特空间。哈密顿量由三角形面上移除最大极化态的正半定投影子构成。
AI.result: 得到了精确的零能基态流形——完全填满的单态环态。自旋关联由环连通性决定。在烧绿石上，四面体对称性消除了局域偏置项，次近邻海森堡微扰导出金刚石晶格上的自旋-1/2 XY模型。
AI.conclusion: 给出了二维和三维中约束价键物理的精确自旋-1微观起点，展示了如何从小自旋、SU(2)不变的阻挫磁体出发逼近环、二聚体和规范理论描述。

title: Topological characterization of multifold band degeneracies in Altland-Zirnbauer symmetry classes
summary: Topological band degeneracies are conventionally characterized by invariants defined on enclosing spheres over which the energy spectrum remains gapped. This program has been completed for minimal degeneracies in all ten Altland-Zirnbauer (AZ) symmetry classes, whereas higher-order degeneracies have been studied almost exclusively under crystalline-symmetry protection. In this work, we characterize generic n-fold band degeneracies whose stability derives solely from AZ symmetries acting locally in momentum space. We find that their codimension grows quadratically with n, placing such multifold nodes in parameter spaces that combine physical momenta with tuning parameters or synthetic dimensions. However, the enclosing sphere paradigm faces a fundamental obstruction: two (n-1)-fold degeneracy loci intersecting at the n-fold band node pierce every enclosing sphere, implying that no uniform spectral gap (and thus no standard homotopy classification) exists. Here, we turn this obstruction into the diagnostic itself. On the nodal manifolds where the two loci intersect the enclosing sphere, complementary spectral gaps are restored, allowing us to characterize each with conventional band invariants. This enables us to establish a two-way correspondence: (1)~the multifold node is topologically protected whenever the nodal manifolds are robustly linked on the enclosing sphere, and (2)~band invariants on cycles of one nodal manifold encode their linking numbers with cycles of the other. We carry out this characterization for minimal models of all ten AZ classes, computing the band invariants wherever an explicit parametrization is available. Our results recast multifold band topology as the topology of linked nodal manifolds in momentum space, while our methods provide the foundation for a general characterization of multifold band degeneracies in models with arbitrarily many bands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法来表征由Altland-Zirnbauer (AZ)对称性保护的多重带简并（n-fold band degeneracies），克服了传统包围球面范式因不存在均匀能隙而失效的问题。作者将障碍转化为诊断工具，通过分析nodal流形在包围球面上的链接关系来定义拓扑保护，并针对所有十类AZ对称性类的最小模型进行了完整的表征。
AI.motivation: 传统方法仅适用于低阶简并（如狄拉克点、外尔点），而高阶简并通常依赖晶格对称性保护。作者希望建立一套通用的、仅基于AZ对称性（在动量空间局域作用）的n重简并拓扑分类理论，填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 1. 识别出传统包围球面范式面临的根本性障碍：两个(n-1)维简并轨迹相交于n重简并点，使得包围球面上不存在均匀能隙；2. 将这一障碍转化为诊断工具：在nodal流形与包围球面相交的节点上，互补能隙恢复，可用传统带不变量表征；3. 建立双向对应关系：(a) 当nodal流形在包围球面上形成稳健链接时，多重简并点具有拓扑保护；(b) 一个nodal流形上循环的带不变量编码其与另一流形循环的链接数；4. 对所有十类AZ类的最小模型进行计算验证。
AI.result: 1. 发现n重简并的余维数随n呈二次增长；2. 将所有十类AZ对称性类中的多重简并点通过nodal流形的链接拓扑进行了统一表征；3. 计算了可用显式参数化模型的带不变量；4. 将多重带拓扑重新表述为动量空间中链接的nodal流形拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一套超越传统包围球面范式的多重带简并拓扑表征框架，将拓扑保护问题转化为动量空间中nodal流形的链接拓扑问题，为任意多带模型中的高阶简并分类提供了普适性理论基础。

title: Halogen control of magnetic competition in Kitaev candidate Ru$X_3$ ($X =$ Cl, Br)
summary: The spin-orbital Mott insulators Ru$X_3$ ($X =$ Cl, Br) have attracted considerable attention as promising candidate materials for realizing a Kitaev spin liquid. In this study, we construct effective pseudospin models from multiorbital Hubbard models derived from first-principles calculations and investigate the magnetic states of RuCl$_3$ and RuBr$_3$. From the constructed effective models, we find that RuBr$_3$ has more extended Wannier orbitals and stronger interlayer exchange interactions than RuCl$_3$. These interactions enhance three-dimensional correlations, consistent with the stronger antiferromagnetic tendency experimentally inferred for RuBr$_3$. Orbital-dependent Coulomb anisotropy further reduces the energy difference between ferromagnetic and zigzag states. Our results clarify how halogen substitution controls magnetic competition in Ru$X_3$ through interlayer exchange interactions and effects of orbital-dependent Coulomb interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理构建有效赝自旋模型，研究了RuCl₃和RuBr₃的磁性质，发现RuBr₃具有更扩展的Wannier轨道和更强的层间交换相互作用，增强了三维磁关联，卤素取代通过层间交换和轨道依赖的库仑相互作用调控磁竞争。
AI.motivation: RuX₃（X=Cl, Br）作为Kitaev自旋液体的候选材料备受关注，但卤素取代如何影响其磁性质尚不清晰，需要从理论上揭示其磁竞争机制。
AI.method: 从第一性原理计算推导多轨道Hubbard模型，构建有效赝自旋模型，分析Wannier轨道扩展性、层间交换相互作用及轨道依赖的库仑各向异性对磁性质的影响。
AI.result: RuBr₃相比RuCl₃具有更扩展的Wannier轨道和更强的层间交换相互作用，增强了三维关联；轨道依赖的库仑各向异性降低了铁磁态与zigzag态之间的能量差。
AI.conclusion: 卤素取代通过调控层间交换相互作用和轨道依赖的库仑相互作用，有效控制了RuX₃中的磁竞争，为理解该类材料的磁性提供了理论基础。

title: Antiphase boundary-driven large exchange bias and negative magnetoresistance in NiCo2O4
summary: Nickel-based spinel oxide has recently attracted significant attention due to its remarkable magneto-transport properties, promising various spintronic applications. In this study, we observe an exchange bias effect, where the magnetic hysteresis loop shifts both horizontally and vertically when single-phase nanocrystalline NiCo2O4 is cooled in the presence of an external magnetic field. The magnitude of the exchange bias field is approximately 375 Oe at 5 K, and this effect disappears around 300 K. Furthermore, NiCo2O4 shows semiconducting behaviour in longitudinal resistivity and demonstrates a substantial negative magnetoresistance of ~31.5% at 10 K. The magnetoresistance exhibits a butterfly-shaped behaviour at low magnetic fields and becomes almost linear at high magnetic fields. A detailed analysis of the negative magnetoresistance and exchange bias reveals that both phenomena originate from the formation of antiphase boundaries in the as-synthesized NiCo2O4 sample, as confirmed by the high-resolution transmission electron micrograph.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了纳米晶NiCo2O4中的交换偏置效应和负磁电阻现象，发现两者均源于反相边界缺陷，交换偏置场约375 Oe（5K），负磁电阻可达~31.5%（10K）。
AI.motivation: 镍基尖晶石氧化物因其优异的磁输运特性在自旋电子学中具有应用潜力，本文旨在探索NiCo2O4的交换偏置效应及其物理机制。
AI.method: 通过外加磁场冷却单相纳米晶NiCo2O4样品，测量磁滞回线的水平和垂直偏移以表征交换偏置；通过纵向电阻率和磁电阻测量分析输运性质；利用高分辨透射电镜确认反相边界的存在。
AI.result: 在5K下观察到约375 Oe的交换偏置场，该效应在300K附近消失；纵向电阻率呈半导体行为；在10K下观测到~31.5%的显著负磁电阻，低场下磁电阻呈蝴蝶形，高场下趋于线性。
AI.conclusion: 负磁电阻和交换偏置均源于合成NiCo2O4样品中形成的反相边界缺陷，HRTEM图像证实了这一结论。

title: Magnetic field-driven phase switching in the antiferromagnetic Mott insulator Ca$_3$(Ru$_{0.99}$Ti$_{0.01}$)$_2$O$_7$
summary: A bandwidth-controlled antiferromagnetic Mott-insulating phase in Ca$_3$(Ru$_{1-x}$Ti$_x$)$_2$O$_7$ is realized through isovalent substitution at the Ru site. For a dilute substitution with only 1% Ti, the Mott insulator ground state remains nearly degenerate with the ground state of pristine Ca$_3$Ru$_2$O$_7$, where the Ru moments are ferromagnetically aligned within the metallic RuO$_2$ bilayers stacked in an antiferromagnetic fashion. The exceptionally shallow free energy landscape of this doped compound arises from intertwined electron-electron and electron-lattice interactions. This makes its magnetic and transport properties highly sensitive to external perturbations. We systematically investigated magnetic-field-induced phase switching in Ca$_3$(Ru$_{0.99}$Ti$_{0.01}$)$_2$O$_7$ to explore its magnetic $H$-$T$ phase diagram. With the field applied along the easy $b$-axis, parallel to the antiferromagnetic moments, the magnetization exhibits a first-order spin-flop transition at $\approx $ 6 T, indicating reorientation of the Ru moments perpendicular to the field. The transition is accompanied by a decrease in the electrical resistance, but the spin-flop phase remains insulating. Above 10.5 T, all Ru moments align with the $b$-axis, resulting in a forced ferromagnetic metallic phase. In contrast, neither spin-flop nor forced-ferromagnetic phases are observed up to 14 T, when the field is applied along the $a$-axis. While the electronic kinetic energy and the electron-lattice coupling contribute to the free-energy balance of this system, the resulting $H$-$T$ phase diagram is remarkably simple and closely resembles that of a canonical anisotropic antiferromagnet, albeit with substantially renormalized critical fields.

AI.tldr: 本文通过等价位掺杂在Ca₃(Ru₁₋ₓTiₓ)₂O₇中实现了带宽控制的反铁磁莫特绝缘相。仅1%的Ti掺杂使莫特绝缘基态与原始金属态几乎简并，磁场诱导的相变揭示了从自旋翻转绝缘相到强制铁磁金属相的转变，H-T相图类似于标准各向异性反铁磁体但临界场被显著重整化。
AI.motivation: 探索通过等价位掺杂调控莫特绝缘体与金属态的竞争，研究弱掺杂下磁性和输运性质对外部扰动的极端敏感性，揭示电子-电子和电子-晶格相互作用的纠缠机制。
AI.method: 通过1% Ti等价位掺杂Ru位，制备Ca₃(Ru₀.₉₉Ti₀.₀₁)₂O₇单晶，系统测量沿不同晶向（b轴和a轴）施加磁场时的磁化强度和电阻率，构建H-T相图。
AI.result: 沿易b轴加场时，在~6 T出现一级自旋翻转相变（绝缘态），10.5 T以上进入强制铁磁金属相；沿a轴加场至14 T无上述相变。H-T相图与标准各向异性反铁磁体类似，但临界场显著重整化。
AI.conclusion: 电子动能和电子-晶格耦合共同贡献自由能平衡，使得弱掺杂体系的H-T相图虽然形式上简单，但临界场的重整化反映了强关联电子体系中电子-电子与电子-晶格相互作用的深层纠缠。

title: The self-organized vacancy order in Pr$_9$Ge$_{16}$
comment: accepted for publication in Phys. Rev. Mater
summary: In this work, we report the discovery of a new crystal structure on the Ge-rich side of the Pr-Ge binary phase diagram. Using a high-temperature flux technique, we grew single crystals of $Pr_9Ge_{16}$, which adopt a previously unreported orthorhombic $Fdd$2 structure type featuring ordered Ge vacancies. We present the anisotropic magnetic properties and identify the crystallographic $b$ axis perpendicular to the crystal plane as the magnetic easy axis. Temperature-dependent resistivity measurements reveal metallic behavior with a distinct anomaly at $T_{\mathrm{C}}$ = 14.3 K. Hall resistivity data indicate that electron-like carriers dominate, with a carrier concentration on the order of $10^{27}~\mathrm{m}^{-3}$. The magnetic order is readily suppressed by a magnetic field of approximately 0.4 T applied along the easy $b$ axis.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在Pr-Ge二元相图富Ge侧发现的一种新的正交晶系Pr₉Ge₁₆晶体结构，该结构具有有序的Ge空位。研究表明其磁易轴为b轴，在14.3 K出现铁磁转变，载流子为电子型，浓度约10²⁷ m⁻³，磁序可被约0.4 T的磁场抑制。
AI.motivation: 在Pr-Ge二元相图的富Ge侧探索尚未报道的新晶体结构，以拓展对该体系的材料学和磁学性质的理解。
AI.method: 采用高温助熔剂法生长Pr₉Ge₁₆单晶，通过结构解析确定其属于正交晶系Fdd2空间群且具有有序Ge空位；进行了各向异性磁性测量、变温电阻率测量和霍尔电阻率测量。
AI.result: 发现了新的Pr₉Ge₁₆正交晶系Fdd2结构；b轴为磁易轴，居里温度T_C=14.3 K；电阻率呈现金属性行为并在T_C处有异常；霍尔效应显示电子型载流子主导，浓度约10²⁷ m⁻³；磁有序可被约0.4 T的磁场（沿b轴）抑制。
AI.conclusion: Pr₉Ge₁₆是一种具有有序Ge空位的新的铁磁材料，其磁各向异性明显，居里温度较低且磁场可轻易抑制其磁序，为稀土锗化物体系提供了新的研究方向。

title: Surface Phase-Field-Crystal-Helfrich model for out-of-plane deformations in thin crystalline sheets with lattice mismatch
summary: Thin, flexible crystalline sheets exhibit unique elastic properties due to their ability to undergo out-of-plane deformations. Understanding this behavior requires a description that couples in-plane elasticity, out-of-plane deformation, and their coupling, taking the crystalline structure and its defects into account. We develop a multiscale description for these systems by extending the surface Phase-Field-Crystal-Helfrich model. The extension permits a spatially varying equilibrium lattice spacing, enabling the representation of localized lattice eigenstrain to mimic lattice mismatch in heterostructures. We validate the extended model against analytical predictions from classical Föppl-von Kármán equations for uniaxial compression and from Eshelby's inclusion problem. Using this validated framework, we then show how locally induced compressive stresses drive out-of-plane deformation in the sheets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扩展表面相场晶体-赫尔弗里希模型，建立了描述薄柔性晶体片弹性的多尺度框架，该模型允许空间变化的平衡晶格间距以模拟异质结构中的晶格失配，并通过经典理论验证后展示了局部压应力如何驱动面外变形。
AI.motivation: 薄柔性晶体片因能发生面外变形而表现出独特的弹性性质，理解这种行为需要耦合面内弹性、面外变形及其相互作用，同时考虑晶体结构及其缺陷的影响。
AI.method: 扩展表面相场晶体-赫尔弗里希（Phase-Field-Crystal-Helfrich）模型，允许空间变化的平衡晶格间距，从而模拟异质结构中的局部晶格本征应变（晶格失配）。
AI.result: 通过单轴压缩的经典Föppl-von Kármán方程和Eshelby夹杂问题的解析预测验证了扩展模型的准确性；并展示了局部压应力如何驱动面外变形。
AI.conclusion: 该多尺度框架能够有效描述薄柔性晶体片中由局部压应力诱发的面外变形行为，为研究含缺陷的晶体异质结构提供了理论工具。

title: Photogeneration and signatures of coherent phonons in time-resolved photoemission spectroscopy: First-principles time-dependent adiabatic GW approach
summary: Coherent lattice dynamics can be observed in pump-probe time-resolved and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (TR-ARPES) as a periodic modulation of intensity and energy of photoelectrons over probe time. We present an ab initio time-dependent GW approach including electron-phonon (e-ph) couplings to simulate the photogeneration of coherent phonons and their effects on the TR-ARPES of monolayer MoS2. We demonstrate that state-resolved e-ph coupling strength can be obtained from analyzing coherent phonon modulations on TR-ARPES. Features of both the impulsive stimulated Raman scattering mechanism and the displacive excitation mechanism of coherent phonon generation are identified in our simulations. We clarify their origins and the coincident selection rule of coherent phonon generation and Raman scattering intensity. This method provides supports to analyze coherent phonon dynamics and e-ph couplings in TR-ARPES and enables quantitative engineering of band structure through coherent phonons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种含时GW方法，结合电子-声子耦合，从头模拟了单层MoS₂中相干声子的光生及其对TR-ARPES的影响，并揭示了相干声子调制与电子-声子耦合强度的关系。
AI.motivation: 作者希望从理论上理解TR-ARPES中观察到的相干声子动力学，并建立从实验信号中提取态分辨电子-声子耦合强度的方法。
AI.method: 采用从头算的含时GW方法，包含电子-声子耦合，对单层MoS₂进行模拟，重现了脉冲激发下相干声子的产生及其对光电子能谱的周期性调制。
AI.result: 成功识别了ISRS和DEC两种相干声子产生机制；发现相干声子调制可提取态分辨的电子-声子耦合强度；阐明了相干声子产生与拉曼散射强度的选择定则一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为分析TR-ARPES中的相干声子动力学和电子-声子耦合提供了理论支撑，并有望通过相干声子实现能带的定量调控。

title: Phase-shifted multicomponent spin-charge nematicity in an altermagnet
summary: Altermagnets host spin-split Fermi surfaces without net magnetization. This intrinsically multicomponent electronic setting raises the possibility that familiar correlated electron phases acquire unconventional spin-charge structure. Here we report the discovery of altermagnetic nematicity in Co0.25NbSe2. Using spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy and spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy, we find that the three nominally C3-related directions lose rotational equivalence in the zero-field state, in both charge and spin-sensitive tunneling channels. Strikingly, the dominant spin-sensitive component is shifted by one C3 sector relative to the dominant charge component, revealing a phase-shifted spin-charge nematic response. A phenomenological theory shows that altermagnetic order favors a finite relative phase between the charge and spin-sensitive nematic components -- C3 lattice pinning frustrates this preferred offset and selects the observed phase locking. These results establish altermagnetic nematicity as a new form of multicomponent electronic liquid-crystal order and point to a potentially generic route by which altermagnets can transform conventional correlated phases into symmetry-engineered spin-charge orders.

AI.tldr: 本文报道在Co0.25NbSe2中发现交变磁向列相，利用STM和自旋极化STM观测到电荷和自旋通道中的旋转对称性破缺，且自旋与电荷分量之间存在相位偏移，揭示了一种新型多组分电子液晶序。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体具有自旋劈裂费米面但无净磁化，这种多组分电子环境可能使传统关联电子相产生非常规的自旋-电荷结构，但目前对此缺乏实验探索。
AI.method: 使用光谱成像扫描隧道显微镜和自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜实验观测，结合唯象理论分析。
AI.result: 在零场下，三个名义上C3相关的方向在电荷和自旋通道中均失去旋转等价性；自旋敏感分量的主导方向相对电荷分量偏移一个C3扇区，形成相位偏移的自旋-电荷向列响应。
AI.conclusion: 交变磁向列相是一种新型多组分电子液晶序，交变磁序倾向于使电荷和自旋向列分量之间存在有限相对相位，C3晶格钉扎阻碍了这种偏好偏移并选择了观测到的相位锁定，为交变磁体将传统关联相转变为对称性工程化的自旋-电荷序提供了通用途径。

title: Strain-Tunable Shift Current and Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect in Multiferroic Altermagnet Fe2Mo3O8
summary: Altermagnetism has recently emerged as a compelling frontier in spintronics, seamlessly merging the agile tunability of ferromagnets with the hallmark merits of antiferromagnets. As a prototypical polar multiferroic featuring distinctive altermagnetism, Fe2Mo3O8 hosts an ideal playground for exploring the intricate interplay among ferroelectric polarization, altermagnetic order, and spin-dependent responses. Here, employing first-principles calculations, we systematically investigate the coupling among polarization, spin splitting, shift current, and magneto-optical responses in Fe2Mo3O8. Our findings reveal that switching the ferroelectric polarization not only inverts the sign of the shift current but also comprehensively reshapes the momentum-space spin-splitting texture. Furthermore, the shift current and magneto-optical spectrum exhibits strong tunability under mechanical strain. Remarkably, the application of a-axis uniaxial strain breaks the crystalline symmetry, thereby activating a finite magneto-optical Kerr effect that is otherwise forbidden in the pristine phase.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，系统研究了极性多铁材料Fe2Mo3O8中电极化、自旋劈裂、位移电流和磁光响应之间的耦合关系，发现铁电极化翻转可重塑自旋纹理，应变能调控位移电流并激活磁光克尔效应。
AI.motivation: 变磁体（altermagnet）融合了铁磁体的可调性与反铁磁体的优势，而Fe2Mo3O8作为典型的极性多铁体兼具铁电极化与变磁有序，为探索三者之间的复杂耦合提供了理想平台。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，系统研究了Fe2Mo3O8中极化、自旋劈裂、位移电流和磁光响应之间的耦合关系。
AI.result: (1) 铁电极化翻转不仅反转位移电流符号，还重塑动量空间自旋劈裂纹理；(2) 位移电流和磁光谱在机械应变下表现出强可调性；(3) a轴单轴应变可打破晶体对称性，激活本征态下被禁止的磁光克尔效应。
AI.conclusion: Fe2Mo3O8中电极化、变磁序与自旋相关响应之间存在强耦合，通过电场和应变可有效调控其光电器件性能，为变磁体在多铁性和自旋电子学中的应用提供了新思路。

title: Single-orbital tight-binding model for chiral one-dimensional hybrid organic-inorganic lead halide perovskites
summary: We present a single-orbital tight-binding model for the low-energy electronic states of the chiral one-dimensional hybrid organic-inorganic lead halide perovskite $\mathrm{(}R/S\mathrm{-PEA)PbI}_3$. The model is constructed from a single effective orbital on each of the four symmetry-related sites in the primitive unit cell and incorporates layer, in-plane sublattice, and spin degrees of freedom. Using separate parameter sets for the conduction and valence bands, the effective Hamiltonian reproduces the overall band dispersions obtained from density-functional-theory calculations and quantitatively captures the spin splittings near the band edges. It also captures the leading spin-polarization patterns of the Bloch states, showing that the band-edge spin splitting and spin polarization are encoded in a small number of symmetry-adapted spin-dependent hopping terms. We further analyze the accidental degeneracies of the effective Hamiltonian using screw eigenvalues and antiunitary operators. This analysis separates accidental degeneracies originating from the restricted term content of the effective Hamiltonian from degeneracies enforced by nonsymmorphic screw symmetries and time-reversal symmetry. The present model provides a symmetry-transparent starting point for understanding the band-edge electronic structure of chiral lead halide perovskites and for analyzing optical, spin, and transport responses in this class of materials.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了手性有机-无机杂化钙钛矿(R/S-PEA)PbI₃的单轨道紧束缚模型，精确再现了DFT计算的能带色散、自旋劈裂和自旋极化模式，并分析了偶然简并的起源。
AI.motivation: 手性有机-无机杂化钙钛矿具有独特的自旋-轨道耦合和手性诱导自旋选择性，但目前缺乏一个既保持对称性透明性又能准确描述低能电子结构的有效模型，以便理解其光学、自旋和输运性质。
AI.method: 基于原胞中四个对称性相关位点的单一有效轨道，构建包含层、面内子晶格和自旋自由度的紧束缚模型。对导带和价带分别使用独立参数集，通过对称性适配的自旋依赖跳跃项拟合DFT能带，并利用螺旋算符本征值和反幺正算符分析偶然简并。
AI.result: 模型定性和定量地再现了DFT能带色散、带边自旋劈裂大小及主导自旋极化模式；发现自旋劈裂和极化仅由少数对称性适配的自旋依赖跳跃项决定；通过螺旋对称性和时间反演对称性成功区分了偶然简并与对称性强制简并。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为理解手性铅卤钙钛矿的带边电子结构提供了一个对称性透明的理论框架，为研究此类材料的光学、自旋和输运响应奠定了基础。

title: Decoupling Strain-Rate Sensitivity and Deformation Length Scale Effects in Neutron-Irradiated Tungsten: A Coupled Nano-Indentation, HR-EBSD and Crystal Plasticity Study
summary: Plastic deformation during strain-rate-controlled spherical nanoindentation is governed by the coupled evolution of constitutive strain-rate sensitivity and deformation length scale, making the intrinsic influence of strain rate difficult to isolate experimentally. This coupling is investigated in unirradiated and neutron-irradiated single-crystal tungsten using spherical nanoindentation, atomic force microscopy, high-resolution electron backscatter diffraction (HR-EBSD), and crystal plasticity finite element (CPFE) modeling. Nanoindentation experiments were performed at strain rates from 3.2e-5 to 3.2e-3 per second. AFM and HR-EBSD quantified surface pile-up, residual lattice strain, and geometrically necessary dislocation (GND) distributions. A strain-gradient CPFE framework incorporating thermally activated slip, GND hardening, irradiation-induced obstacle hardening, and strain-dependent softening was calibrated using a single experimental condition and validated across all remaining strain rates without further parameter adjustment. The validated model was then used to independently vary strain rate and indentation depth. Simulations show that strain rate primarily controls the stress required for thermally activated plastic flow, whereas indentation depth governs plastic-zone evolution, pile-up, and GND accumulation. Irradiation increases obstacle strength and promotes deformation localization while remaining consistent with a common thermally activated mechanism. The framework also predicts the compression response of a polycrystalline cube, demonstrating transferability across loading conditions and length scales, providing a robust basis for constitutive modeling of irradiation-hardened materials under transient loading.

AI.tldr: 本文通过联合实验和晶体塑性有限元建模，研究了单晶钨在辐照前后球形纳米压痕中应变率与变形长度尺度的耦合效应，发现应变率主要控制热激活塑性流动应力，而压痕深度主导塑性区演化、堆积和几何必需位错积累。
AI.motivation: 球形纳米压痕中，应变率敏感性与变形长度尺度耦合演化，使得应变率的本征影响难以通过实验独立分离，需结合建模手段解耦。
AI.method: 采用球形纳米压痕实验（应变率3.2e-5~3.2e-3/s）、AFM、HR-EBSD表征，并结合基于应变梯度的CPFE模型（含热激活滑移、GND硬化、辐照障碍硬化和应变软化），在单一条件下标定模型后跨应变率验证。
AI.result: 模型无参数调整即可预测所有其他应变率下的响应；应变率控制热激活应力，压痕深度控制塑性区、堆积和GND分布；辐照增强障碍强度并促进变形局部化。
AI.conclusion: 该CPFE框架可迁移至多晶压缩等不同加载条件，为辐照硬化材料在瞬态加载下的本构建模提供了稳健基础。
